makaleler.baslik: Restorative resection in robot-assisted versus laparoscopic total mesorectal excision: systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Robotik ve Laparoskopik Total Mezorektal Eksizyonda Restoratif Rezeksiyon Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 7133 hastalık 20 çalışmayı içeren meta-analizde, R-TME ile primer anastomoz oranı L-TME'ye göre anlamlı yüksek bulundu (OR 1,43, %95 CI 1,04-1,98). Anastomoz kaçağı ve komplikasyonlar benzerken, açık cerrahiye dönüşüm R-TME'de düşüktü (OR 0,37). 2020 sonrası çalışmalarda restoratif cerrahi olasılığı daha da belirgindi (OR 2,86).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The surgical treatment of rectal cancer is based on the principle of total mesorectal excision (TME). Owing to its technological advantages, robot-assisted total mesorectal excision (R-TME) is hypothesized to facilitate primary anastomosis more frequently than laparoscopic total mesorectal excision (L-TME). This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to investigate whether R-TME is associated with a higher likelihood of restorative surgery compared with L-TME.
METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. The protocol was prospectively registered in PROSPERO, the international prospective register of systematic reviews (registration number: 1106767). PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies from January 2010 to January 2026. Pooled ORs and mean differences were calculated using a random-effects model.
RESULTS: Twenty studies were included, reporting on 7133 patients. The pooled analysis demonstrated a significantly higher likelihood of restorative surgery with R-TME compared with L-TME (OR 1.43 (95% c.i. 1.04 to 1.98)). In a subgroup analysis of studies including patients after 2020, a stronger effect was observed (OR 2.86 (95% c.i. 1.80 to 4.53)). No significant differences were observed in anastomotic leakage, postoperative complications, reoperations, and readmissions. R-TME was associated with a lower conversion rate compared with L-TME (OR 0.37 (95% c.i. 0.28 to 0.49)).
CONCLUSION: R-TME is associated with a higher likelihood of primary anastomosis formation while maintaining a comparable safety profile. The more pronounced effect in recent studies likely reflects increasing surgical expertise. Future research should determine whether these advantages translate into measurable improvements in patient quality of life.

makaleler.baslik: A systematic review and meta-analysis of preoperative MRI-based pelvimetry in predicting surgical difficulty in rectal cancer: Implications for personalised surgical planning.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rektum Kanserinde Preoperatif MR Pelvimetrisinin Cerrahi Zorluğu Öngörmedeki Rolü
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 36 çalışmayı (8364 hasta) içeren sistematik derlemede, 6 çalışmalık meta-analiz (769 hasta) değerlendirildi. Daha kısa interspinöz mesafe (MD -5,13 mm; p<0,001) ve intertüberöz mesafe (MD -7,32 mm; p=0,004) cerrahi zorluk göstergeleriyle anlamlı ilişkili bulundu. Bulgular kişiselleştirilmiş cerrahi planlamaya katkı sağlayabilir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based pelvimetry has been investigated for predicting surgical difficulty in total mesorectal excision (TME) for rectal cancer. However, heterogeneity in pelvimetric parameters, surrogate outcomes, and study design has resulted in inconsistent evidence. This systematic review aimed to synthesise the evidence on commonly used MRI parameters and difficulty surrogates and assess their methodological robustness and clinical relevance.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were systematically searched through December 2025 for studies evaluating preoperative MRI pelvimetry in patients undergoing TME for rectal cancer. Outcome parameters were surrogate measures of surgical difficulty, including operating time, intraoperative blood loss, conversion to open surgery, pathological quality metrics, and postoperative complications. Risk of bias was assessed using the Risk of Bias in Non-randomised Studies of Exposures (ROBINS-E) tool. This systematic review and meta-analysis was reported in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 statement and prospectively registered (PROSPERO: CRD420261287153).
RESULTS: Thirty-six studies comprising 8,364 patients were included. Common parameters included sagittal measurements and axial interspinous distance (ISD) and intertuberous distance (ITD). Definitions of surgical difficulty varied substantially. ROBINS-E identified some concerns in 30 studies, a high risk of bias in five, and insufficient information in one. Meta-analysis of six studies (n = 769) showed that shorter ISD (mean difference [MD] -5.13 mm, 95% CI -6.61 to -3.65; p < 0.001; I2 = 0%) and ITD (MD -7.32 mm, 95% CI -10.24 to -4.39; p = 0.004; I2 = 0%) were significantly associated with surrogate measures of surgical difficulty.
CONCLUSIONS: MRI-based pelvimetry, particularly ISD and ITD, may help predict surgical difficulty in TME. However, methodological heterogeneity limits broader quantitative synthesis and highlights the need for standardised pelvimetric protocols.

makaleler.baslik: Telemedicine interventions after colorectal surgery: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolorektal Cerrahi Sonrası Teletıp Müdahaleleri: Sistematik Derleme ve Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 13 çalışmayı (5 RCT, 8 kohort) içeren meta-analizde, teletıp uygulamaları ile standart bakım arasında 30 günlük hastaneye yeniden yatış (OR 0,96; 7102 hasta) ve acil servis başvurularında (OR 1,02; 6694 hasta) fark saptanmadı. Teletıp grubunda hasta memnuniyeti anlamlı düzeyde daha yüksek bulundu (SMD 0,88; 217 hasta).
makaleler.ozet:
AIM: There has been increasing interest in telemedicine follow-up after surgery. This study aims to synthesize the literature regarding the effect of postoperative telemedicine after colorectal surgery on 30-day readmission and emergency department visit rates compared with usual care.
METHOD: Relevant databases were searched until September 12, 2025. Two authors independently identified trials, extracted data, assessed risk of bias (ROB 2.0 and ROBINS-I), and evidence certainty (GRADE). Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and controlled observational studies were included. Meta-analyses were conducted using random-effects models. Primary outcomes were 30-day readmissions and 30-day emergency department visits. Secondary outcomes included patient satisfaction and compliance with the telemedicine intervention.
RESULTS: Thirteen studies (five RCTs, eight cohort studies) were included. Compared to usual care, telemedicine resulted in no difference in 30-day readmissions (odds ratio [OR]; 0.96; 95% CI: 0.69, 1.35, 11 studies, 7102 patients, low certainty) and 30-day emergency department visits (OR; 1.02; 95% CI: 0.67, 1.57, 8 studies, 6694 patients, low certainty). Evidence certainty was limited by serious imprecision and moderate to high risk of bias. Patient compliance with interventions ranged from 48.6% to 95.3% across studies. Patient satisfaction was higher for telemedicine compared to usual care (standardized mean difference; 0.88; 95% CI: 0.31, 1.45, 3 studies, 217 patients).
CONCLUSION: Telemedicine interventions may lead to little difference in readmissions or emergency department visits after colorectal surgery. Telemedicine may improve patient satisfaction versus usual care. Evidence was of low certainty, indicating a need for larger randomized trials and high-quality observational studies with appropriate design and analysis to minimize confounding.

makaleler.baslik: Postoperative Day 2 C-reactive Protein Identifies Patients at Low Risk of Anastomotic Leakage After Colon Cancer Resection.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolon Kanseri Cerrahisi Sonrası POD2 CRP ile Düşük Kaçak Riskinin Belirlenmesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Test (401 hasta) ve validasyon (213 hasta) kohortlarında postoperatif 2. gün CRP <100 mg/L olanlarda anastomotik leak oranı sırasıyla %1,3 ve %1,0, negatif prediktif değer ise %98,8 ve %99,0 bulundu. POD3/POD2 oranının <1 olması ek risk sınıflaması sağlayarak ERAS kapsamında hastaların yaklaşık %90'ının erken taburculuğunu destekledi.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To determine whether C-reactive protein (CRP) <100 mg/L on postoperative day (POD) 2 excludes anastomotic leakage (AL) after colon cancer resection.
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: CRP <100 mg/L on POD3 is widely used to exclude AL, but enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) increasingly discharges patients before POD3, highlighting the need for an earlier biochemical criterion.
METHODS: This two-cohort multicenter diagnostic accuracy study included patients undergoing elective colon cancer resection with primary anastomosis. AL was defined as Clavien-Dindo grade ≥3. POD2 CRP <100 mg/L was evaluated for excluding AL. In patients with POD2 CRP ≥100 mg/L, POD3 dynamics were evaluated using a POD3/POD2 ratio <1.
RESULTS: AL occurred in 4.0% and 4.7% of patients in test (n=401) and validation (n=213) cohorts. POD2 CRP <100 mg/L was present in 240 (60%) and 97 (46%) patients, with AL in only 1.3% and 1.0%, yielding negative predictive values (NPVs) of 98.8% and 99.0%. In contrast, AL occurred in 8.1% and 7.8% of patients with POD2 CRP ≥100 mg/L. In the combined cohort, a POD3/POD2 ratio <1 further stratified risk among these higher-risk patients, with NPVs of 98.9% and 97.9% for minimally invasive and open surgery, respectively, and using this two-step strategy, nearly 90% of patients could be discharged by POD2 or 3 with AL risk near 1%.
CONCLUSIONS: POD2 CRP <100 mg/L, supplemented by selective POD3 reassessment, provides a simple algorithm to support safe early discharge after colon cancer resection within ERAS pathways.

makaleler.baslik: Development and external validation of a nomogram to predict survival and guide surgical strategy for colorectal cancer with synchronous liver and lung metastases: a SEER-based analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Senkron Karaciğer ve Akciğer Metastazlı Kolorektal Kanserde Cerrahi Strateji Nomogramı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: SEER verileriyle geliştirilen (808 eğitim, 345 iç, 65 dış validasyon hastası) 9 değişkenli nomogramda 12 aylık AUC değerleri 0,714-0,791 saptandı. Nomogram tabanlı risk sınıflandırmasında primer tümör rezeksiyonunun sağkalım faydasının büyük ölçüde düşük riskli hasta grubunda sınırlı olduğu gösterildi.
makaleler.ozet: Surgical management of colorectal cancer with synchronous liver and lung metastases (CRC-SLLM) remains challenging because of marked clinical heterogeneity, and reliable tools for individualized risk assessment are lacking. We aimed to develop and externally validate a nomogram for overall survival (OS) prediction and to explore its potential value in guiding selection for primary tumor resection (PTR). Patients diagnosed with CRC-SLLM between 2010 and 2015 were identified from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database and randomly assigned to a training cohort (n = 808) and an internal validation cohort (n = 345) in a 7:3 ratio, whereas external validation was performed using 65 patients from the Fourth Hospital of Hebei Medical University, China. After feature selection with least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression, a multivariable Cox-based nomogram was constructed, and its performance was assessed using time-dependent receiver operating characteristic curves, calibration plots, decision curve analysis (DCA), and risk stratification. The final nomogram incorporated nine predictors: age, primary tumor site, histological grade, tumor size, N stage, bone metastasis, carcinoembryonic antigen status, metastasectomy, and chemotherapy. It showed stable discrimination across the training, internal validation, and external validation cohorts, with 12-month areas under the curve (AUCs) of 0.791, 0.714, and 0.778 and 24-month AUCs of 0.742, 0.740, and 0.730, respectively; calibration was good in all cohorts, and DCA supported potential clinical utility. Nomogram-based risk stratification separated patients into prognostically distinct low- and high-risk groups, and an exploratory analysis indicated that the survival benefit of PTR was largely confined to low-risk patients. This externally validated nomogram provides individualized survival prediction and risk stratification for patients with CRC-SLLM and may help identify those more likely to benefit from PTR, although this finding remains exploratory and warrants confirmation in prospective multicenter studies.

turk.baslik: The colorectal cancer screening gap in Türkiye: A tripartite survey of barriers among patients and surgeons.
turk.baslik_tr: Türkiye'de Kolorektal Kanser Taramasındaki Boşluk: Hasta ve Cerrah Engelleri
turk.kisa_ozet: 100 taranmamış hasta, 100 kolonoskopi hastası ve 50 cerrahın anketinde, hastaların %54'ünün tarama farkındalığı olmadığı, kolonoskopilerin %77'sinin semptomlar nedeniyle yapıldığı saptandı. Cerrahlar en önemli engeller olarak uzun bekleme sürelerini (%90) ve yetersiz endoskopist sayısını (%92) belirtti.
turk.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: Colorectal cancer (CRC) screening uptake in Türkiye remains suboptimal, despite the presence of a national screening program. Understanding whether barriers arise primarily from patient-related factors or system-level constraints is essential for effective policy planning. This study aimed to evaluate barriers to CRC screening across the screening pathway using patient, procedural, and provider perspectives.
MATERIAL AND METHODS: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted between January and June 2025 at a tertiary training and research hospital. Three distinct groups were surveyed: 100 screening-naïve outpatients aged 50-70 years, 100 patients undergoing diagnostic or screening colonoscopy, and 50 general surgeons performing or referring for colonoscopy. Study-specific questionnaires, pilot-tested for clarity but not formally validated, were used to assess screening awareness, attitudes, perceived barriers, and strategies for improvement. The data were analyzed descriptively.
RESULTS: Among screening-naïve outpatients, 54% had no prior awareness of CRC screening, and only 28% had received a physician recommendation for screening. Fear of a serious diagnosis (45%) and pain or discomfort (40%) were commonly reported concerns; however, most respondents indicated that these would not deter screening. Among patients undergoing colonoscopy, 77% underwent the procedure for symptoms rather than preventive screening, while post-procedure satisfaction was high. Surgeons predominantly identified system-level barriers, particularly long waiting times (90%) and an insufficient number of trained endoscopists (92%), as major limitations in effective screening delivery.
CONCLUSION: The primary perceived barrier to CRC screening in Türkiye appears to be limited system capacity rather than patient reluctance. Improving screening uptake will likely require coordinated public awareness efforts, structured national reminder systems, and expansion of the number of adequately trained endoscopists, alongside endoscopy infrastructure.

tez.baslik: Distal rektum tümörü tanılı hastalarda inflamatuar belirteçler ve nutrisyon durumu neoadjuvan tedavinin yanıtını öngörebilir mi ?
tez.baslik_tr: Distal Rektum Kanserinde İnflamatuar Belirteçlerin Neoadjuvan Tedavi Yanıtını Öngörmedeki Rolü
tez.kisa_ozet: Distal rektum kanserli 102 hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, klinik tam yanıt oranı %47,8 (n=53) saptandı. Tam yanıt grubunda neoadjuvan öncesi lenfosit, albümin, LMR ve lenfosit/CRP yüksek; CRP, CEA, NLR ve PLR düşük bulundu. Tedavi yanıtının öngörülmesinde sistemik inflamatuar belirteçler anlamlı iken, BT temelli psoas ölçümleri farksızdı.
tez.ozet: Giriş ve Amaç: Lokal ileri distal rektum tümöründe neoadjuvan tedavilere verilecek yanıtın önceden öngörülememesi, organ koruyucu yaklaşım seçimini ve cerrahi tedavinin planlanmasını zorlaştırmaktadır. Bu çalışmanın amacı klinikte rutin olarak kullanılan sistemik inflamatuar ve nutrisyonel belirteçlerin neoadjuvan tedaviye yanıtını öngörmedeki rolünü ortaya koymaktır. Hastalar ve Yöntemler: 2013–2025 yılları arasında İstanbul Üniversitesi İstanbul Tıp Fakültesi Genel Cerrahi Anabilim Dalı Gastrointestinal Cerrahi Biriminde neoadjuvan tedavi alan distal rektum kanseri tanılı hastalar retrospektif olarak değerlendirildi. Çalışma kriterlerini karşılayan 111 hasta çalışmaya katıldı. Neoadjuvan tedavi sonrası klinik tam yanıt (kTY) saptanan 53 hasta tam yanıt (TY) grubuna dahil edildi. Cerrahi uygulanan hastalarda Dworak regresyon skoru değerlendirilemeyen 9 hasta yanıt analizine alınmadı. Dworak III–IV regresyon skoru saptanan 9 hasta iyi yanıt grubuna, Dworak 0–I–II regresyon skoru saptanan 40 hasta ise parsiyel yanıt (PY) grubuna dahil edildi. Böylece ana analiz, 62 hastadan oluşan TY grubu ile 40 hastadan oluşan PY grubu karşılaştırılarak gerçekleştirildi. Lökosit, lenfosit, trombosit, monosit, nötrofil, CEA, albümin, CRP, kolesterol, trigliserit, Nötrofil/Lenfosit oranı (NLR), Trombosit/Lenfosit oranı (PLR), Lenfosit/Monosit oranı (LMR), lenfosit/C Reaktif Protein oranı (CRP) , Modifiye Glaskow Prognostic Score (mGPS), Naple Prognostik Score (NPS) ve bilgisayarlı tomografi (BT) temelli psoas kas ölçümleri bu gruplar arasında karşılaştırıldı. Bulgular: Çalışmaya takip verisi tam olan, neoadjuvan tedavi almış distal rektum tümörü tanılı 102 hasta dahil edildi. Hastaların yaş ortalaması 60.4±11.6 yıl olup, olguların %61.8'i erkekti. kTY oranı %47.8 (n=53) olarak saptandı ve bu hastalar izle ve gör (İvG) protokolünde ameliyat edilmeden yakın takibe alındı. Yanıt analizinde, kTY saptanan 53 hasta ile cerrahi sonrası Dworak III–IV regresyon skoru bulunan 9 hasta TY grubuna dahil edilirken, Dworak 0–I–II regresyon skoru saptanan 40 hasta PY olarak değerlendirildi. Dworak regresyon skoru değerlendirilemeyen 9 hasta yanıt analizine alınmadı. TY grubunda neoadjuvan tedavi öncesi lenfosit, albümin, LMR ve lenfosit/CRP oranı daha yüksek; CRP, CEA, NLR ve PLR düzeyleri ise daha düşük bulundu. Neoadjuvan tedavi sonrası dönemde tam yanıt grubunda kolesterol, lenfosit, albümin, LMR ve lenfosit/CRP oranı daha yüksek; nötrofil, NLR ve PLR düzeyleri daha düşüktü. mGPS neoadjuvan tedavi sonrası tam yanıt grubu lehine anlamlı farklılık gösterirken, NPS ve BT temelli psoas kas ölçümleri açısından gruplar arasında anlamlı fark saptanmadı. Sonuç: Distal rektum tümörü tanılı hastalarda neoadjuvan tedaviye tam yanıt gelişimi, daha düşük sistemik inflamasyon ve daha iyi immün-nütrisyonel durum ile ilişkili bulunmuştur. Özellikle lenfosit, albümin, LMR, lenfosit/CRP oranı, NLR, PLR, CRP, CEA ve mGPS gibi kolay ulaşılabilir parametreler tedavi yanıtının öngörülmesinde yardımcı olabilir. Buna karşılık NPS ve BT temelli psoas kas ölçümleri tedavi yanıtı ile anlamlı ilişki tespit edilmemiştir. Bu bulguların daha geniş, çok merkezli ve prospektif çalışmalarla desteklenmesi gerekmektedir.

makaleler.baslik: Impact of Side-to-Side Versus End-to-Side Gastrojejunostomy on the Rate of Delayed Gastric Emptying After Pancreatoduodenectomy (IPAD study): A Randomized Controlled Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreatikoduodenektomide Yan-Yana ve Uç-Yana Gastrojejunostominin Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 158 hastalık RKÇ'de pankreatikoduodenektomi sonrası yan-yana ve uç-yana gastrojejunostomi karşılaştırıldı. Gecikmiş mide boşalması oranları sırasıyla %38,0 ve %30,4 bulundu (RR 1,25; %95 CI 0,81-1,94; p=0,314). Fistül, reoperasyon ve mortalite oranlarında gruplar arasında anlamlı fark saptanmadı.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether side-to-side gastrojejunostomy (SSGJ) reduces delayed gastric emptying (DGE) compared with end-to-side gastrojejunostomy (ESGJ) after pancreatoduodenectomy (PD).
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: DGE is one of the most frequent complications after PD, leading to prolonged recovery and increased morbidity. Retrospective studies have suggested that the configuration of the gastrojejunostomy may influence DGE, but no randomized trial has confirmed this.
METHODS: The IPAD study was a prospective, randomized, open-label trial conducted at 2 high-volume pancreatic centers in France. Adult patients undergoing PD for benign or malignant disease were randomized intraoperatively (1:1) to SSGJ or ESGJ and followed for 90 days. The primary endpoint was the incidence of DGE. Secondary endpoints included postoperative complications, nutritional outcomes, and quality of life (QoL) assessed at 90 days using the GastroIntestinal Quality of Life Index (GIQLI).
RESULTS: From May 1, 2021 to July 1, 2023, among 171 screened patients, 158 were randomized (79 per group). Baseline characteristics were comparable except for sex distribution and rates of hypertension and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. DGE occurred in 38.0% of patients after SSGJ and 30.4% after ESGJ (risk ratio 1.25; 95% CI: 0.81-1.94; P =0.314). Rates of pancreatic fistula, biliary fistula, reintervention, and mortality were similar. At 90 days, nutritional parameters and GIQLI scores (87.9 vs. 86.6; P =0.68) did not differ between groups.
CONCLUSIONS: The present RCT found no significant difference in the rate of DGE between SSGJ and ESGJ. Postoperative outcomes, nutritional status, and quality of life were comparable, indicating that both techniques yielded comparable outcomes.

makaleler.baslik: Postoperative complications following hepatectomy for hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with Child-Pugh B liver function: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Child-Pugh B Hastalarda Hepatosellüler Karsinom İçin Hepatektomi Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Child-Pugh B 1238 HCC hastasını içeren 14 çalışmanın meta-analizinde genel komplikasyon %38,22, majör komplikasyon %14,87 bulundu. Majör komplikasyon oranı açık cerrahide minimal invaziv yaklaşıma göre anlamlı yüksekti (%18,18'e karşı %7,83; p=0,01). 30 ve 90 günlük mortalite oranları sırasıyla %1,09 ve %2,56 saptandı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Liver resection is a curative option for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but its safety in patients with Child-Pugh B cirrhosis remains incompletely defined, and quantitative complication benchmarks are lacking.
METHODS: This systematic review and single-proportion meta-analysis followed PRISMA Harms guidelines. PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, and Cochrane Library were searched for studies reporting outcomes after curative-intent hepatectomy in Child-Pugh B HCC patients. Pooled proportions were calculated using generalized linear mixed models with logit transformation and random-effects models.
RESULTS: 14 studies comprising 1238 patients were included. The pooled overall complication rate (Clavien-Dindo grade I-V) was 38.22% (95% CI, 30.05%-47.12%), and the trim-and-fill adjusted major complication rate (Clavien-Dindo ≥ III) was 14.87% (95% CI, 10.48%-20.67%). The 30-day and 90-day mortality rates were 1.09% (95% CI, 0.20%-5.59%) and 2.56% (95% CI, 1.43%-4.53%), respectively. Surgical approach was a significant moderator of major complications (open 18.18% vs. minimally invasive 7.83%; P = 0.01).
CONCLUSION: These findings provide preliminary quantitative safety estimates that offer a useful reference for clinicians and patients and may help frame shared decision-making at the patient level.

makaleler.baslik: Bilateral external oblique intercostal block combined with intravenous patient-controlled analgesia for multimodal analgesia after laparoscopic cholecystectomy: a single-center randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik Kolesistektomide Bilateral Eksternal Oblik İnterkostal Blok
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 56 hastalık prospektif RKÇ'de laparoskopik kolesistektomide bilateral eksternal oblik interkostal blok (EOIB), 24 saatlik opioid tüketimini %46,5 azalttı (p<0,001). EOIB grubunda QoR-15 skoru daha yüksek (140'a karşı 131; p<0,001) ve ilk gaza çıkış süresi daha kısa bulundu (18'e karşı 20 saat; p=0,031).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative pain after laparoscopic cholecystectomy (LC) remains common and peaks within 24 h. Opioid-based analgesia improves pain but can delay recovery, prompting opioid-sparing regional techniques within ERAS pathways.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether adding bilateral ultrasound-guided external oblique intercostal plane block (EOIB) to standard intravenous patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) improves early analgesia and recovery after elective LC.
METHODS: In a prospective, single-centre, randomized controlled parallel trial, 56 patients were randomized (1:1) to receive bilateral EOIB (n=28) or no regional block (control, n=28). All patients received standardised anesthesia and PCA with butorphanol. The primary outcome was total butorphanol consumption within 24 h postoperatively. Secondary outcomes included pain scores, Quality of Recovery at 24 h, time to first flatus, nausea and vomiting, intraoperative haemodynamic events, and length of hospital stay.
RESULTS: EOIB significantly reduced 24 h butorphanol consumption [median 3.7 (IQR 3.2-4.8) mg vs. 7.2 (6.2-7.6) mg, equivalent to 18.5 vs. 36.0 mg intravenous morphine]. After adjustment, opioid consumption was 46.5% lower (95% CI 38.3-53.6; P<0.001). EOIB also increased QoR-15 at 24 h (median 140 vs. 131; P<0.001) and shortened time to first flatus (median 18 vs. 20 h; P=0.031). Cough-pain VRS scores were lower with a significant group-by-time interaction (P=0.013). Intraoperative haemodynamics did not differ, and PONV was numerically lower without statistical significance.
CONCLUSION: Bilateral EOIB with standard PCA provides clear opioid-sparing effects after LC without increasing safety risks.
STUDY REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT07332546.

makaleler.baslik: Feasibility and perioperative outcomes of Senhance-assisted robotic cholecystectomy: a single-arm meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Senhance Destekli Robotik Kolesistektominin Uygulanabilirliği ve Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 198 hastayı kapsayan 8 çalışmanın tek kollu meta-analizinde Senhance robotik kolesistektominin cerrahi başarı oranı %96 (%95 CI %90-99) bulundu. Birleşik operasyon süresi 81,48 dk, konsol süresi 39,35 dk, docking süresi 11,54 dk ve hastanede kalış süresi 1,89 gün olarak hesaplandı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The Senhance Digital Laparoscopy System (SDLS) is an emerging robotic platform with distinctive features, including haptic feedback, eye-tracking camera control, and reusable instruments compatible with standard laparoscopic trocars. However, comprehensive evidence regarding its application in cholecystectomy remains limited. This single-arm meta-analysis was designed to consolidate the current evidence by quantitatively synthesizing key perioperative outcomes-including operative time, console time, docking time, surgical success rate, and postoperative length of hospital stay-to provide a comprehensive, evidence-based assessment of the feasibility and perioperative outcomes of Senhance-assisted robotic cholecystectomy.
METHODS: To identify potentially relevant publications, the following electronic databases were systematically queried from their respective inception dates through August 1, 2026: Web of Science, Embase, PubMed, and Cochrane Library. Eligible studies were those reporting perioperative outcomes of Senhance-assisted cholecystectomy. The analysis focused on operative time and console time as primary measures, with docking time, hospital stay, and surgical success rate as secondary measures. all meta-analyses were performed using random-effects models. Subgroup analyses were performed based on economic level, study design, and sample size. Assessment of study quality was conducted using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) case series Critical Appraisal Checklist.
RESULTS: Eight studies comprising 198 patients were included. The pooled operative time was 81.48 min (95% CI: 78.52 to 84.44; I² = 0.0%), console time was 39.35 min (95% CI: 33.29 to 45.41; I² = 90.0%), docking time was 11.54 min (95% CI: 8.37 to 14.70; I² = 96.2%), and length of hospital stay was 1.89 days (95% CI: 0.81 to 2.97; I² = 97.9%). The pooled surgical success rate was 96% (95% CI: 90% to 99%; I² = 50.7%). Subgroup analysis for docking time revealed a significant difference by sample size (p = 0.038), while console time showed no significant differences across subgroups. Sensitivity analysis demonstrated the robustness of the findings for operative time, console time, docking time, and surgical success rate, whereas the length of hospital stay was significantly influenced by a single study (Sasaki, 2023). All included studies were rated as high quality with low risk of bias.
CONCLUSIONS: The findings of this single-arm meta-analysis indicate that Senhance-assisted robotic cholecystectomy is both safe and feasible, demonstrating a high surgical success rate, acceptable operative times, and a short postoperative hospital stay. The console time is comparable to that of conventional laparoscopic cholecystectomy, while docking time remains a modifiable factor that can be optimized through experience and team training. However, the heterogeneity in length of hospital stay across countries highlights the influence of different healthcare policies. Future prospective, multicenter comparative studies are warranted to further define the role of this platform in minimally invasive surgery.

makaleler.baslik: Long-Term Effects of Biliopancreatic Diversion (BPD), Biliopancreatic Diversion with Duodenal Switch (BPD-DS), and Single Anastomosis Duodeno‑Ileal Bypass with Sleeve Gastrectomy (SADI‑S) in Patients with Obesity: A Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Obezitede BPD, BPD-DS ve SADI-S'nin Uzun Dönem Etkileri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2156 hastayı içeren 22 çalışmanın meta-analizinde BPD ve BPD-DS ile ortalama VKİ azalması 19,02 kg/m² oldu. RYGB'ye göre BPD/BPD-DS daha fazla VKİ düşüşü (fark 6,31 kg/m²) ve diyabet remisyonu sağladı (OR 3,49; %95 CI 1,11-10,91). Uzun dönemde revizyon cerrahisi %3, anemi %19 ve kemik sorunları %25 bulundu.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: The long-term outcomes of biliopancreatic diversion (BPD), BPD with duodenal switch (BPD-DS), and single anastomosis duodeno-ileal bypass with sleeve gastrectomy (SADI-S) in patients with obesity are not well established.
METHODS: A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science was conducted until October 11, 2025, following PRISMA guidelines. Studies reporting outcomes at ≥ 10 years following the specified procedures were included.
RESULTS: A total of 22 studies with 2156 patients were included. BPD and BPD-DS were associated with a mean BMI reduction of 19.02 kg/m². BPD-DS achieved total weight loss (TWL) of 36.34% and an excess weight loss (EWL) of 75.22%. Resolution rates for diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and obstructive sleep apnea were 78%, 63%, 83%, and 89%, respectively. Major long-term complications included revision surgery (3%), anemia (19%), iron deficiency (34%), and bone disorders (25%). Compared with RYGB, BPD and BPD-DS achieved greater BMI reduction (mean difference 6.31 kg/m², 95% CI: 3.16, 9.47) and higher diabetes resolution (OR 3.49, 95% CI: 1.11, 10.91), but with a higher rate of cholecystectomy. Diabetes relapse after BPD and BPD-DS occurred in 15% of patients, with significant reductions in fasting blood sugar and HbA1c. Limited data from two studies on SADI-S showed sustained weight loss (TWL 34.4%, EWL 80.4%) but notable rates of reoperation due to nutritional complications.
CONCLUSION: Overall, BPD and BPD-DS provide lasting weight loss and metabolic benefits, but careful patient selection and ongoing multidisciplinary care are important because of the risk of malnutrition. Long-term data on SADI-S appear promising but remain limited.

turk.baslik: Lemmel syndrome: A single-center cohort and diagnostic considerations.
turk.baslik_tr: Lemmel Sendromu: Tek Merkez Kohortu ve Tanısal Yaklaşımlar
turk.kisa_ozet: 12 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif seride, periampuller duodenal divertikülün safra yoluna basısıyla gelişen Lemmel sendromu değerlendirilmiştir. Tanıda ultrasonografinin sıklıkla yetersiz kaldığı, MRCP'nin anatomik ilişkiyi net gösterdiği ve ERCP ile biliyer stentleme gibi endoskopik girişimlerin küratif olduğu bildirilmiştir.
turk.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: Lemmel syndrome is an uncommon cause of obstructive jaundice resulting from extrinsic compression of the common bile duct by a periampullary duodenal diverticulum (PAD) in the absence of choledocholithiasis. Due to its non-specific clinical presentation, diagnosis may be delayed or misinterpreted.
MATERIAL AND METHODS: A retrospective review was conducted on 12 patients diagnosed with Lemmel syndrome at a single tertiary center between 2022 and 2024. Demographic characteristics, clinical presentation, laboratory findings, imaging modalities [ultrasonography (USG), computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP)], endoscopic interventions, and outcomes were analyzed descriptively.
RESULTS: The cohort included 12 patients with a mean age of 70±9 years. All patients presented with clinical or biochemical evidence of obstructive jaundice. USG frequently failed to establish the diagnosis, whereas CT and particularly MRCP demonstrated the anatomical relationship between the PAD and the biliary tree. Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography served both diagnostic and therapeutic purposes, with biliary stenting performed when indicated. Most patients improved with conservative and/or endoscopic management.
CONCLUSION: Lemmel syndrome should be considered in elderly patients with unexplained obstructive jaundice. Cross-sectional imaging, particularly MRCP, plays a key role in diagnosis, while endoscopic intervention remains central to management.

tez.baslik: Alkolik karaciğer hastalığı nedeniyle yapılan karaciğer nakilleri: Tek merkezli deneyim
tez.baslik_tr: Alkolik Karaciğer Hastalığında Karaciğer Nakli Sonuçları: Tek Merkez Deneyimi
tez.kisa_ozet: Alkolik karaciğer hastalığı nedeniyle nakil yapılan 124 hastanın retrospektif analizinde (%93,5 canlı vericili), 1, 3 ve 5 yıllık kümülatif sağkalım oranları %76,6, %68,9 ve %66,1 bulunmuştur. Akut alkolik hepatit ve siroz gruplarında benzer sağkalım elde edilmiş; nakil değerlendirmesinde alkol bırakma süresinin tek kriter olmaması gerektiği belirtilmiştir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışma, alkolik karaciğer hastalığı nedeniyle karaciğer nakli (KN) yapılan hastaların demografik, klinik, biyokimyasal ve sağkalım özelliklerini analiz etmeyi; özellikle akut alkolik hepatit (AAH) ve siroz arasındaki farklılıklara vurgu yapmayı amaçlamıştır. Materyal ve metot: Toplam 124 KN alıcısının klinik ve laboratuvar verileri, görüntüleme bulguları ve ameliyat sonrası sonuçları retrospektif olarak değerlendirilmiştir. Hastalar, önce uluslararası tanı kriterlerine göre [AAH (n=34; %27,4) ve siroz (n=90, %72,6)] iki gruba ayrılmıştır. Ardından merkezimizin KN ekibi ve hepatobiliyer sistem konusunda deneyimli radyoloğun görüşleri temel alınarak AAH ve siroz şeklinde yeniden sınıflandırılarak karşılaştırılmıştır. İstatistiksel analizler için Mann–Whitney U, Ki-kare ve Kaplan–Meier sağkalım testleri kullanılmıştır. Bulgular: Hastaların çoğu erkekti (%96,8) ve medyan yaş 53 yıl idi. Canlı vericili karaciğer nakli (CVKN), olguların %93,5'ini oluşturmaktaydı ve ortanca MELD-Na skoru 19 olarak hesaplanmıştır. AAH grubunda total bilirubin, AST, AST/ALT oranı, GGT ve lenfosit düzeyleri anlamlı derecede daha yüksekti. Transplant ekibinin ve radyoloğun önerdiği sınıflamaya göre bakıldığında siroz grubundaki karaciğerlerin radyolojik volümü ve eksplant karaciğer ağırlığı anlamlı olarak daha küçük bulunmuştur. KN sonrası 1. 3. ve 5. yıllardaki sağkalım oranları sırasıyla %76,6, %68,9 ve %66,1 olarak hesaplanmıştır. İlginç bir şekilde mortalite gelişen grupta KN sonrası alkole başlama oranının daha düşük olduğu görülmüştür (p=0,001). KN sonrası mortalitenin başlıca nedenleri pulmoner (n=43,3) ve biliyer (n=23,3) komplikasyonlardı. AAH ve siroz sınıflamaları için kulanılan üç sınıflama sistemi arasında korelasyon bulunmamasına rağmen, benzer sağkalım sonuçları elde edilmiştir. Sonuç: Alkolik karaciğer hastalığı nedeniyle yapılan KN, kabul edilebilir uzun dönem sağ kalım sonuçlar vermektedir. Literatür verileriyle birarada değerlendirildiğinde, AAH ve siroz olarak tanımlanan hastaların uzun dönem sonuçları benzerlik gösterdiği için KN için hasta değerlendirirken alkol kulanım ve bırakma sürelerinin temel belirleyici olarak baz alınmamasının uygun olacağı kanaatindeyiz. Anahtar kelimeler: Alkolik karaciğer hastalığı; Akut alkolik hepatit; Karaciğer sirozu; Canlı vericili karaciğer nakli. ABSTRACT AlcoholicLiver Transplants Performed Due to Liver Disease: A Single-Center Experience Objective: This study aimed to analyze the demographic, clinical, biochemical, and survival characteristics of patients who underwent liver transplantation (LT) due to alcoholic liver disease, with a particular emphasis on the differences between acute alcoholichepatitis and cirrhosis.Material and methods: The clinical and laboratory data, imaging findings, and postoperativeoutcomes of a total of 124 LT recipientswere retrospectively evaluated. Patients were first divided into two groups according to international diagnostic criteria [acute alcoholic hepatitis (AAH; n=34; 27.4%] and cirrhosis (n=90,72.6%)]. Then, based on the opinions of our center's KN team and a radiologist experienced in the hepatobiliary system, they were reclassified as AAH and cirrhosis and compared. Statistical analyses were performed using the Mann–WhitneyU, Chi-square, and Kaplan–Meier survival tests. Findings: Most patients were male (96.8%) and the median age was 53 years. Living donor liver transplantation accounted for 93.5% of cases, and the median MELD-Na score was calculated as 19. In the AAH group, total bilirubin, AST, AST/ALT ratio, GGT, and lymphocyte levels were significantly higher. According to the classification recommended by the transplant team and radiologist, the radiological volume of livers in the cirrhosis group and the explant liver weight were found to be significantly smaller. Survival rates at 1, 3, and 5 years after KN were calculated as 76.6%, 68.9%, and 66.1%, respectively. Interestingly, the rate of alcohol initiation after KN was lower in the group that developed mortality (p=0.001). The main causes of mortality after KN were pulmonary (n=43) and biliary (n=23) complications. Although no correlation was found between the three classification systems used for AAH and cirrhosis, similar survival results were obtained. Conclusion: KN performed due to alcoholic liver disease yields acceptable long-term survival outcomes. When evaluated in conjunction with literature data, we believe that since the long-term outcomes of patients defined as AAH and cirrhosis are similar, it is appropriate not to base patient evaluation for KN primarily on alcohol consumption and cessation periods. makaleler.baslik: Impact of Side-to-Side Versus End-to-Side Gastrojejunostomy on the Rate of Delayed Gastric Emptying After Pancreatoduodenectomy (IPAD study): A Randomized Controlled Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreatikoduodenektomide Yan-Yana ve Uç-Yana Gastrojejunostominin Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 158 hastalık RKÇ'de pankreatikoduodenektomi sonrası yan-yana ve uç-yana gastrojejunostomi karşılaştırıldı. Gecikmiş mide boşalması oranları sırasıyla %38,0 ve %30,4 bulundu (RR 1,25; %95 CI 0,81-1,94; p=0,314). Fistül, reoperasyon ve mortalite oranlarında gruplar arasında anlamlı fark saptanmadı.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether side-to-side gastrojejunostomy (SSGJ) reduces delayed gastric emptying (DGE) compared with end-to-side gastrojejunostomy (ESGJ) after pancreatoduodenectomy (PD).
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: DGE is one of the most frequent complications after PD, leading to prolonged recovery and increased morbidity. Retrospective studies have suggested that the configuration of the gastrojejunostomy may influence DGE, but no randomized trial has confirmed this.
METHODS: The IPAD study was a prospective, randomized, open-label trial conducted at 2 high-volume pancreatic centers in France. Adult patients undergoing PD for benign or malignant disease were randomized intraoperatively (1:1) to SSGJ or ESGJ and followed for 90 days. The primary endpoint was the incidence of DGE. Secondary endpoints included postoperative complications, nutritional outcomes, and quality of life (QoL) assessed at 90 days using the GastroIntestinal Quality of Life Index (GIQLI).
RESULTS: From May 1, 2021 to July 1, 2023, among 171 screened patients, 158 were randomized (79 per group). Baseline characteristics were comparable except for sex distribution and rates of hypertension and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. DGE occurred in 38.0% of patients after SSGJ and 30.4% after ESGJ (risk ratio 1.25; 95% CI: 0.81-1.94; P =0.314). Rates of pancreatic fistula, biliary fistula, reintervention, and mortality were similar. At 90 days, nutritional parameters and GIQLI scores (87.9 vs. 86.6; P =0.68) did not differ between groups.
CONCLUSIONS: The present RCT found no significant difference in the rate of DGE between SSGJ and ESGJ. Postoperative outcomes, nutritional status, and quality of life were comparable, indicating that both techniques yielded comparable outcomes.

makaleler.baslik: Gastrointestinal symptoms and health-related quality of life before and after pancreatectomy for pancreatic cancer (GO-PANC): longitudinal nationwide study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreas Kanseri Cerrahisi Öncesi ve Sonrası Gastrointestinal Semptomlar ve Yaşam Kalitesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1009 hastalık prospektif kohortta, cerrahi öncesi hastaların %95'inde gastrointestinal semptom saptandı. Semptomlar ameliyat sonrası 0-3. aylarda zirve yaptı ve 9-12. aylarda preoperatif düzeylere geriledi. Şiddetli semptomlar 9-12. ayda %61'den %52'ye indi; iki veya daha fazla semptomu olanlarda HRQoL skorlarında belirgin düşüş görüldü.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Patients undergoing pancreatectomy for pancreatic cancer may experience gastrointestinal symptoms that impair health-related quality of life (HRQoL) before and after pancreatic surgery. The longitudinal course of these symptoms and their association with HRQoL remains unclear as large prospective studies are lacking.
METHODS: Patients who underwent pancreatectomy for pancreatic cancer and filled out questionnaires of the Dutch Pancreatic Cancer Project were included in this cohort study. Gastrointestinal symptoms and HRQoL were assessed before surgery and 0-3, 3-6, 6-9, and 9-12 months after surgery. Multivariable generalized linear mixed models were applied to evaluate longitudinal changes in gastrointestinal symptoms and their association with HRQoL.
RESULTS: After pancreatectomy for pancreatic cancer, overall, 1009 patients were included and 2995 questionnaires were completed. Before surgery, gastrointestinal symptoms were present in 95% of patients; commonly flatulence, dry mouth, problems with taste, and altered bowel habits. Gastrointestinal symptom scores peaked at 0-3 months after surgery and generally returned to preoperative or lower levels at 9-12 months after surgery. Severe gastrointestinal symptoms (defined as 'quite a bit' or 'very much') decreased from 61% of patients before surgery to 52% at 9-12 months after surgery. Patients with two or more severe symptoms had moderate (10-20 points) to large (>20 points) clinically relevant lower scores for HRQoL.
CONCLUSION: Gastrointestinal symptoms in patients undergoing pancreatectomy for pancreatic cancer were highly prevalent and peaked within 3 months after surgery. Severe gastrointestinal symptoms affected more than half of all patients after surgery, which led to substantial declines in HRQoL.

makaleler.baslik: Improving predictive accuracy for surgical indication of the current management guideline for intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm of the pancreas via cutoff adjustments.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreatik IPMN Kılavuzlarında Cerrahi Endikasyon Eşik Değerlerinin Doğruluğunun Artırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 418 hastalık retrospektif çalışmada, mevcut HRS kriterlerinin duyarlılığı %82,7, özgüllüğü %66,9 bulundu. EMN ve MPD eşik değerleri yükseltildiğinde HRS özgüllüğü sırasıyla %76,7, %82,4 ve %89,9'a çıktı. Modelin 6 puanlık ölçek AUC değeri 0,771'den 0,795-0,808 aralığına yükselerek cerrahi endikasyon tahminini iyileştirdi (p=0,046).
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To improve the predictive accuracy of international guidelines for malignant pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm (IPMN) via cutoff adjustments.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed surgically confirmed IPMN patients at a single center between 2011 and 2023. Preoperative MRI were reviewed based on international guidelines. We calculated sensitivity and specificity of high-risk stigmata (HRS). Receiver operating characteristic analyses for enhancing mural nodule (EMN) size and main pancreatic duct (MPD) diameter identified cutoffs achieving specificities of 85%, 90%, and 95%. Revised HRS criteria (HRS-85/90/95) and 6-point scales were established based on these cutoffs, and compared with the original HRS-based 6-point scale using DeLong's test.
RESULTS: Of 418 patients (mean age, 66.6 ± 8.2 years; 263 men) analyzed, 173 had malignant IPMN. The original HRS showed 82.7% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 76.2-88.0%) sensitivity and 66.9% (95% CI: 60.7-72.8%) specificity. Obstructive jaundice and suspicious/positive cytology were highly specific (98.8-99.6%), but EMN ≥ 5 mm and MPD ≥ 10 mm were less specific (80.4%). Feature-level thresholds achieving specificities of ≥85%, 90%, and 95% were 9.5/12.0/17.5 mm for EMN and 11.0/12.0/13.5 mm for MPD. Optimism-corrected sensitivities and specificities of HRS-85, 90, and 95 were 74.4%/76.7%, 65.2%/82.4%, and 53.1%/89.9% (95% CIs: 68.2-80.9%/71.0-80.2%, 58.4-72.8%/78.0-86.5%, and 45.7-60.1%/85.7-93.5%), respectively. The 6-point scale area under the curve (AUC) improved from 0.771 to 0.795-0.808 (apparent AUC differences, 0.027-0.041; Holm-Bonferroni adjusted p = 0.046).
CONCLUSION: Current HRS criteria carry a high false-positive rate for malignancy. Increasing EMN and MPD cutoffs improves specificity and AUC, though sensitivity decreases. Thresholds should be optimized according to the clinical context.
KEY POINTS: Question Current surgical indications for pancreatic IPMN show high false-positive rate for malignancy; therefore, improving predictive accuracy for malignant IPMN is warranted. Findings Revised HRS criteria with increased EMN and MPD cutoffs revealed higher specificity at the expense of sensitivity, and significantly improved 6-point scale AUC. Clinical relevance Adjusting cutoff values for EMN size and MPD diameter improves specificity and AUC in predicting malignancy for IPMN, potentially guiding more targeted surgical interventions. However, the associated reduction in sensitivity necessitates a balanced, individualized assessment in clinical practice.

makaleler.baslik: Pan-European Training Program for Robotic Pancreatoduodenectomy (LEARNBOT): Prospective Multicenter Study on Feasibility and Outcome.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Robotik Pankreatoduodenektomi İçin Pan-Avrupa Eğitim Programı: Prospektif Çok Merkezli Çalışma
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 20 merkezde 486 robotik pankreatoduodenektomi yapılan prospektif çalışmada medyan kan kaybı 200 mL, konversiyon %18,3 ve 30 günlük mortalite %2,7 bulundu. Clavien-Dindo grade >=III komplikasyon %31,4, POPF %21,2 gelişti. Simülasyon eğitimiyle OSATS skorları anlamlı arttı (p<0,001) ve işlem hataları azaldı (p=0,006).
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To assess the feasibility of and clinical outcomes after a pan-European training program for robotic pancreatoduodenectomy (RPD).
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: The implementation of RPD into clinical practice comes with considerable challenges, leading to concerns about patient safety, oncological outcomes, and costs. To address this, a structured training program was implemented in which 2 surgeons at each of the 20 sites were trained and maintained as a consistent operative team.
STUDY DESIGN: A structured training program for RPD was implemented, and outcomes were prospectively collected in 20 European high-volume centers, all without previous RPD experience, from 12 countries. The program included a video library, biotissue simulation (pancreaticojejunostomy and hepaticojejunostomy), off-site RPD case observations, and on-site proctoring. Surgeons' simulation anastomoses were assessed using Objective Structured Assessment of Technical Skills (OSATS) and technical errors. The primary endpoint was intra- and postoperative patient outcome. A key secondary analysis assessed safety using OSATS scores and error counts during the biotissue training..
RESULTS: Overall, 486 RPD procedures were performed. Median intraoperative blood loss was 200 mL (IQR: 100-400), operative time was 475 minutes (IQR: 414-553.3), and the conversion rate was 18.3% (n=89). The rate of Clavien-Dindo grade ≥III complications was 31.4% (n=153), POPF was 21.2% (n=103), delayed gastric emptying was 15% (n=73), postpancreatectomy hemorrhage was 8.6% (n=42), and in-hospital/30-day mortality was 2.7% (n=13). Median length of stay was 12 days (IQR: 8-20). During simulation training, OSATS scores significantly improved (0.350 points/attempt ( ρ ), P <0.001) while the duration of reconstruction decreased ( P <0.001). There was a significant decrease of the total number of errors made during consecutive attempts in the biotissue training (0.175 errors decrease per attempt, P =0.006]).
CONCLUSIONS: We report on the first successfully completed international training program for RPD. Simulation established a standardized technical competency, although a learning-curve effect (POPF) remained detectable per center. These data highlight that safe adoption of complex procedures requires structured, team-based, proctored training beyond simulation alone.

makaleler.baslik: Do structural ICU requirements reflect critical care demand in elective metabolic and bariatric surgery? A retrospective cohort study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Elektif Bariatrik Cerrahide Yoğun Bakım İhtiyacı ve Merkez Gereksinimleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1065 hastalık retrospektif çalışmada (351 bariatrik cerrahi, 714 laparoskopik kolesistektomi) 30 günlük komplikasyon oranı sırasıyla %4,27 ve %3,64 saptandı. Yerinde yoğun bakım ünitesi bulunmayan merkezde bariatrik cerrahi grubunda hiçbir hasta yoğun bakıma ihtiyaç duymadı (%0; %95 CI üst sınır %1,05).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS) is increasingly delivered in lower-acuity settings, yet on-site intensive care unit (ICU) capability remains a structural requirement for the highest center-designation tier. Direct data on critical-care utilization after elective MBS without an on-site ICU are limited. We describe 30-day outcomes at such a center, using contemporaneous elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy (LC) in the same environment as a reference.
METHODS: Retrospective cohort study of consecutive adults undergoing elective MBS (sleeve gastrectomy or Roux-en-Y gastric bypass) or LC (2022-2025) at a single center without an on-site ICU but with a pre-defined escalation and transfer protocol. The primary outcome was the 30-day complication rate (Clavien-Dindo); ICU utilization was grade ≥IV. Outcomes are reported descriptively with 95% confidence intervals (CIs); regression and propensity-score-matched analyses are exploratory (Supplementary Material).
RESULTS: Of 1,065 patients (MBS n=351, LC n=714), 30-day complication rates were 4.27% (95% CI 2.39-6.94%) versus 3.64% (95% CI 2.37-5.27%). No MBS patient was admitted to intensive care (0/351), compatible with a true rate up to 1.05% (upper 95% CI); two LC patients required ICU admission (0.28%), both for retained-stone acute pancreatitis. All five MBS reoperations were for postoperative hemorrhage; none developed organ dysfunction or met ICU-transfer criteria, and none died. Because events were rare, this study cannot exclude clinically meaningful ICU demand, and absence of a detected difference does not establish equivalence.
CONCLUSIONS: In this single-center experience, elective MBS without an on-site ICU under a structured escalation protocol showed no observed ICU admissions over 30 days, though the confidence interval remains compatible with infrequent critical-care need. These hypothesis-generating findings demonstrate feasibility in one environment and should not be generalized to accreditation policy; prospective multicenter data are required.
STUDY REGISTRATION: Research Registry (UIN: researchregistry11829); retrospectively registered; https://www.researchregistry.com.

tez.baslik: Periampuller tümör nedeniyle gerçekleştirilen pankreatikoduodenektomi ameliyatı sonuçlarının güncel risk skorlarına göre değerlendirilmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Pankreatikoduodenektomi Sonuçlarının ACS NSQIP ve HALP Skorlarına Göre Değerlendirilmesi
tez.kisa_ozet: Pankreatikoduodenektomi uygulanan 179 hastada mortalite %7,8, majör komplikasyon %19,6, genel komplikasyon %30,2 saptandı. Majör komplikasyon öngörüsünde ACS NSQIP ve HALP benzer bulunurken (p=0,3458), genel komplikasyon tahmininde ACS NSQIP anlamlı üstünlük gösterdi (p=0,0339).
tez.ozet: Giriş: Pankreatikoduodenektomi, periampuller tümörler için temel küratif tedavi yöntemidir; ancak yüksek morbidite ve mortalite oranları ile karakterizedir. Bu çalışmada, erken postoperatif komplikasyon sonuçlarının değerlendirilmesi ve ACS NSQIP Cerrahi Risk Hesaplayıcısı ile HALP skorunun prediktif performanslarının karşılaştırılması amaçlanmıştır. Gereç ve Yöntemler: Bu tek merkezli retrospektif çalışmada, Ağustos 2016 ile Mart 2025 tarihleri arasında pankreatikoduodenektomi uygulanan toplam 179 hasta incelendi. Demografik veriler, cerrahi ve patolojik bulgular, preoperatif laboratuvar değerleri ve komorbiditeler kaydedildi. Her hasta için 30 günlük morbidite ve mortalite riskleri ACS NSQIP kullanılarak hesaplandı. HALP skoru hemoglobin, albümin, lenfosit ve trombosit düzeylerinden elde edildi. Prediktif performans ROC analizi ile değerlendirildi. Bulgular: Hastaların %57,5'i erkek olup, medyan yaş 61 yıl idi. Olguların %89,4'ünde malignite saptandı. En sık uygulanan cerrahi yöntem pilor koruyucu pankreatikoduodenektomi (%71,5) idi. Mortalite oranı %7,8, ciddi komplikasyon oranı %19,6 ve herhangi bir komplikasyon oranı %30,2 olarak bulundu. Majör komplikasyonların öngörülmesinde ACS NSQIP Cerrahi Risk Hesaplayıcısı ile HALP skoru benzer performans gösterdi (p=0,3458). Herhangi bir komplikasyonun öngörülmesinde ACS NSQIP, HALP skoruna göre anlamlı derecede üstün bulundu (p=0,0339). Mortalitenin öngörülmesinde iki yöntem arasında anlamlı fark saptanmadı (p=0,5771). Sonuç: Pankreatikoduodenektomi sonrası postoperatif komplikasyonlar ve mortalitenin öngörülmesinde ACS NSQIP Cerrahi Risk Hesaplayıcısı ve HALP skoru anlamlı prediktif değere sahiptir. ACS NSQIP herhangi bir komplikasyonu öngörmede üstün performans gösterirken, HALP skoru klinik uygulamada düşük maliyetli, basit ve tamamlayıcı bir biyobelirteç olarak kullanılabilir.

makaleler.baslik: Current status of minimally invasive surgery for thoracic esophageal diverticula: systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Torasik Özofagus Divertiküllerinde Minimal İnvaziv Cerrahi: Sistematik Derleme ve Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 21 gözlemsel çalışmayı ve 390 hastayı içeren meta-analizde torasik divertiküllere minimal invaziv cerrahi incelendi. Stapler hattı kaçağı %9,8 (%95 CrI 7,1-13,4), toplam komplikasyon %21,6, mortalite %1,3 ve semptom düzelmesi %92,1 saptandı. Miyotomi (RR 0,67) veya cerrahi yaklaşımın (RR 0,72) kaçak üzerinde istatistiksel farkı gösterilemedi.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Thoracic esophageal diverticula, including epiphrenic and parabronchial types, are rare clinical entities representing about 30% of all esophageal diverticula. Thoracic diverticula of the pulsion type have traditionally been associated with motility disorders and treated by stapled diverticulectomy with or without myotomy/fundoplication in patients experiencing disabling symptoms of dysphagia, regurgitation or pulmonary aspiration. Purpose of this study was to review the existing literature and estimate outcomes of minimally invasive surgery.
METHODS: Systematic review and meta-analysis. PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Central Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov were queried. The search was last updated on April 20, 2026. Outcomes were staple-line leak, overall complications, in-hospital mortality, and symptoms improvement.
RESULTS: Twenty-one observational studies including 390 patients were analyzed. The age of the patients ranged from 23 to 83 years. Dysphagia (86%), regurgitation (73.4%), and respiratory symptoms (31.2%) were common indications for surgery. The size of the diverticula ranged from 2 to 11 cm. Preoperative use of standard or high-resolution esophageal manometry was reported in 18 studies. Achalasia (49.2%) was the most commonly associated motility disorder. Laparoscopic (61.9%), thoracoscopic (30.6%), or combined (6.7%) minimally invasive approaches were described. Adjunctive procedures were esophagomyotomy (87%) and Dor (34.6%) or Toupet (17.7%) fundoplication. The estimated pooled prevalence of staple-line leak was 9.8% (95% CrI 7.1-13.4%; I2 = 0.0). Exploratory unadjusted subgroup analyses did not identify statistically supported differences in staple-line leak according to myotomy (RR = 0.67; 95% CrI 0.17-3.52) or surgical approach (RR = 0.72; 95% CrI 0.22-3.39). The estimated pooled prevalence of overall complications, in-hospital mortality, and study-reported symptom resolution/improvement was 21.6% (95% CrI 16.1-28.4%), 1.3% (95% CrI 0.5-2.9%), and 92.1% (95% CrI 87.7-95%), respectively.
CONCLUSIONS: Current evidence reporting outcome for minimally invasive midesophageal and epiphrenic diverticulectomy is limited by study design and treatment heterogeneity. Future well-designed multicenter studies are required to assess the effect of surgical approach and esophageal myotomy on short-term morbidity, symptomatic outcomes, and recurrence rate.

makaleler.baslik: Insufficient Implementation of Recommendations in Pregnancies after Bariatric Surgery: Results from a Nationwide Real-World Study in Germany (PABS Study).
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariyatrik Cerrahi Sonrası Gebeliklerde Kılavuz Uyumsuzluğu: Ulusal Çok Merkezli Çalışma
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Bariyatrik cerrahi geçiren 380 gebeliğin incelendiği kohortta, kadınların %16'sı ameliyattan <1 yıl sonra gebe kaldı. Gebelik öncesi %35'i takviye almadı ve %52'si eksiklik taraması yaptırmadı. Anemi %40, küçük doğum ağırlıklı bebek %20 ve sezaryen %46 oranında izlendi; bariyatrik cerrahi sonrası kılavuz önerilerine uyumun yetersiz olduğu görüldü.
makaleler.ozet: Introduction Bariatric metabolic surgery (MBS) is increasingly performed in women of reproductive age. Although MBS reduces obesity-related pregnancy complications, altered metabolism and nutritional deficiencies may adversely affect maternal and neonatal outcomes. This study evaluated (1) adherence to current guideline recommendations and (2) pregnancy outcomes in women after MBS in Germany. Materials and Methods In this multicenter cohort study, 410 pregnancies after MBS were collected between 2023 - 2025; 380 cases with complete data on BMI, MBS type, and birth weight were finally analyzed. Maternal characteristics, surgical details, preconceptional and prenatal care, and perinatal outcomes were descriptively assessed and compared with national reference data. Results Preconceptional BMI was 30.1 kg/m 2 , 52% of the women were obese. Most common procedures were Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB; 58%) and sleeve gastrectomy (38%). Overall, 16% of the women conceived < 1 year after MBS, 27% after 1 - 2 years, and 57% after > 2 years. Before conception, 35% of the women neither received supplementation nor assessment for deficiencies (52%); similar rates were observed during pregnancy. Anemia occurred in 40%, particularly after RYGB. Oral glucose tolerance testing for gestational diabetes screening was used in 33% despite recommendations against it after MBS. Gestational diabetes was diagnosed in 23%. Rates of small and large for gestational age newborns were 20% and 6%, respectively; preterm birth occurred in 10% and C-section in 46%. Conclusions High rates of anemia and SGA highlight the need for specialized high-risk pregnancy care after MBS. Several guideline recommendations regarding surgery-to-conception interval, supplementation, and GDM screening were not consistently followed.

makaleler.baslik: Survival outcomes following total intravenous versus volatile anesthesia in esophagogastric cancer surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Özofagogastrik Kanser Cerrahisinde TIVA ve Volatil Anestezinin Sağkalım Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 13 çalışma ve 264.543 hastayı içeren meta-analizde, küratif rezeksiyon uygulanan hastalarda TIVA'nın volatil anesteziye kıyasla genel sağkalımı anlamlı derecede artırdığı gösterildi (HR 0,80, %95 CI 0,69-0,93; p=0,003). Bu sağkalım avantajı gastrektomi uygulanan hastalarda belirginken (HR 0,74; p<0,004), özofajektomide anlamlı bulunmadı (p=0,29).
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Esophagogastric cancers remain among the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Surgical resection represents the primary curative treatment strategy; however, perioperative factors may influence long-term oncological outcomes. Experimental and clinical evidence suggests that anesthetic techniques may affect tumor progression and recurrence through immunological and oncological pathways. Total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA) has been proposed to exert immunomodulatory and antitumor effects compared to volatile anesthesia (VA), although evidence remains inconclusive. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the impact of TIVA versus volatile anesthesia on survival outcomes in patients undergoing esophagogastric cancer surgery.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines. PubMed and Scopus were searched for studies published between 2010 and 2025 comparing TIVA with volatile anesthesia in adult patients undergoing curative surgery for esophageal or gastric cancer. The primary outcome was overall survival (OS). Secondary outcomes included recurrence-free survival (RFS), early mortality, operation time, and postoperative hospital stay. Pooled hazard ratios (HR), risk ratios (RR), and mean differences (MD) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were calculated using random-effects models.
RESULTS: Thirteen studies (3 randomized controlled trials and 10 retrospective studies) involving 264,543 patients were included. Of these, 41,977 patients received TIVA and 222,566 received volatile anesthesia. Pooled analysis of eight studies demonstrated significantly improved overall survival with TIVA (HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.69-0.93; p = 0.003). Subgroup analysis showed a significant survival benefit in patients undergoing gastrectomy (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.60-0.91; p < 0.004), whereas no significant difference was observed for esophagectomy (HR 0.89, 95% CI 0.73-1.10; p = 0.29). TIVA was associated with non-significant trends toward improved recurrence-free survival (HR 0.91, 95% CI 0.77-1.06; p = 0.22) and reduced early mortality (HR 0.90, 95% CI 0.77-1.05; p = 0.17). No statistically significant differences were observed in operation time (MD - 3.81 min, 95% CI - 10.75 to 3.13) or hospital stay (MD - 0.19 days, 95% CI - 0.39 to 0.00; p = 0.06).
CONCLUSIONS: TIVA may be associated with improved long-term survival outcomes compared with volatile anesthesia in patients undergoing esophagogastric cancer surgery, particularly among patients undergoing gastrectomy. Given the predominance of retrospective evidence and methodological heterogeneity, further high-quality prospective randomized studies are required to clarify the oncological impact of anesthetic techniques in upper gastrointestinal cancer surgery.

makaleler.baslik: Indocyanine green-guided lymphadenectomy and survival of patients with gastric cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis of time-to-event data.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Mide Kanseri Cerrahisinde İndosiyanin Yeşili Kılavuzluğunda Lenfadenektomi ve Sağkalım Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 7 çalışma ve 7.518 hastayı içeren meta-analizde ICG kılavuzluğunda lenfadenektomi; 3 yıllık genel sağkalımı (HR 0,635, %95 CI 0,511-0,790) ve hastalıksız sağkalımı (HR 0,682, %95 CI 0,530-0,877) artırdı. Çıkarılan lenf nodu sayısı anlamlı yükselirken (WMD 6,557, p=0,000), postoperatif komplikasyon oranında fark saptanmadı (RR 0,899, p=0,527).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Indocyanine green fluorescence imaging (ICG-FI) is increasingly used for lymph node mapping in gastric cancer (GC) surgery, but its impact on long-term oncologic outcomes remains unclear. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the long-term survival benefits of ICG-guided lymphadenectomy compared with conventional surgery.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library were searched from inception to November 2025, supplemented by clinical trial registries. Studies comparing ICG-guided versus non-ICG-guided lymphadenectomy in GC patients were included. Primary outcomes were overall survival (OS) and disease-free survival (DFS). Secondary outcomes included lymph node yield and postoperative complications. Random-effects models were used, and Bayesian analyses estimated the probability of survival benefit.
RESULTS: Seven studies comprising 7518 patients were included. ICG significantly improved 3-year OS (HR = 0.635, 95% CI 0.511-0.790, P = 0.000), 3-year DFS (HR = 0.682, 95% CI 0.530-0.877, P = 0.003), and 5-year OS (HR = 0.700, 95% CI 0.507-0.966, P = 0.030), with Bayesian posterior probabilities of 100%, 100%, and 99.1%, respectively. No significant differences were observed for 2-year OS or DFS. ICG significantly increased lymph node yield (WMD = 6.557, 95% C1 3.821-9.294, P = 0.000) without increasing postoperative complications (RR = 0.899, 95% CI 0.647-1.250, P = 0.527).
CONCLUSION: ICG-guided lymphadenectomy is associated with improved long-term survival and increased lymph node dissection without increasing complications. These findings support ICG-FI as a valuable adjunct in gastric cancer surgery. Further high-quality randomized trials are warranted to validate these results in diverse populations and settings.

makaleler.baslik: Treatment Outcomes for Gastric Cancer With Positive Peritoneal Lavage Cytology or Localized Peritoneal Metastasis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: CY1 veya P1a Mide Kanserinde Tedavi Stratejilerinin Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: CY1 ve/veya P1a mide kanserli 1.181 hastanın incelendiği kohortta, neoadjuvan kemoterapi sonrası gastrektomi yapılanlarda 5 yıllık sağkalım %39,9 iken primer gastrektomi ve adjuvan kemoterapi grubunda %31,4 bulundu (p=0,01). En yüksek 5 yıllık sağkalım, kemoterapi sonrası P0CY0 dönüşümü sağlanarak gastrektomi yapılan grupta elde edildi (%50,5).
makaleler.ozet:
IMPORTANCE: In the era of modern systemic chemotherapy, the optimal treatment strategy for gastric cancer with positive peritoneal lavage cytology (CY1) and/or localized peritoneal metastasis (P1a) remains controversial.
OBJECTIVE: To explore the optimal treatment strategy for patients with gastric cancer with CY1 and/or P1a by comparing the outcomes of various therapeutic strategies.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study was a retrospective multicenter study set in 48 institutions of the Stomach Cancer Study Group in the Japan Clinical Oncology Group. Participants were patients with gastric cancer with CY1 and/or P1a, but no other distant metastases, who were treated in 2016 to 2022. Data were analyzed from July 2025 to May 2026.
EXPOSURE: Patients were stratified according to initial treatment: upfront gastrectomy (n = 838 [71%]) or upfront chemotherapy (n = 343 [29%]). The upfront chemotherapy group was further subdivided into chemotherapy alone (n = 205), gastrectomy after conversion to P0CY0 (n = 92), and nonconversion gastrectomy (n = 46) according to preoperative chemotherapy efficacy.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was overall survival (OS), and secondary outcomes included progression-free survival.
RESULTS: Among 1181 patients, the median (IQR) age was 72 (65-78) years; 725 patients (61%) were male and 456 (39%) were female. The overall 5-year OS rate was 25.0% (95% CI, 22.3%-28.0%), with a median survival time of 24.3 months. Upfront gastrectomy showed a significantly longer OS than upfront chemotherapy (5-year OS: 27.6% vs 19.0%; hazard ratio, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.69-0.93; P = .004). Among the multimodal treatment strategies, upfront chemotherapy followed by gastrectomy showed a significantly higher 5-year OS rate than upfront gastrectomy with postoperative chemotherapy (39.9%; 95% CI, 31.7%-50.2%, vs 31.4%; 95% CI, 27.6%-35.8%; P = .01). Gastrectomy alone and chemotherapy alone showed poor prognoses (10.3% and 3.2%, respectively). Notably, survival after gastrectomy following conversion to P0CY0 was the most favorable (5-year OS: 50.5%), whereas that without P0CY0 was modest (5-year OS: 17.2%).
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This study found that for gastric cancer with CY1 and/or P1a, upfront chemotherapy followed by gastrectomy resulted in a slightly higher 5-year OS rate than upfront gastrectomy followed by postoperative chemotherapy. Because gastrectomy after conversion to P0CY0 was associated with the most favorable survival, the development of more effective preoperative chemotherapy is warranted.

tez.baslik: Neoadjuvan kemoterapi alan ve küratif gastrektomi uygulanan mide adenokarsinomlu hastalarda vücut kompozisyon analizinin tümör evresi sağkalım ve ameliyat sonrası morbidite ile ilişkisinin retrospektif değerlendirilmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Mide Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Kemoterapi Sırasındaki Kas Kaybının Prognostik Önemi
tez.kisa_ozet: Küratif gastrektomi yapılan 110 mide adenokarsinomlu hastada majör komplikasyon %11,8 saptanmıştır. Statik sarkopeni veya sarkopenik visseral obezite morbidite ve sağkalımla ilişkisiz bulunurken, NAKT sürecindeki dinamik iskelet kası kaybı evreden bağımsız kötü genel sağkalımı öngörmüştür (düzeltilmiş HR 0,94 ve 0,95; p=0,003 ve p=0,004).
tez.ozet: AMAÇ: Bu çalışmada, neoadjuvan kemoterapi (NAKT) alan ve küratif gastrektomi uygulanan mide adenokarsinomlu hastalarda, bilgisayarlı tomografi tabanlı L3 düzeyinde vücut kompozisyon analizinin (VKA) tümör evresi, genel sağkalım ve postoperatif morbidite ile ilişkisinin retrospektif olarak değerlendirilmesi amaçlanmıştır. GEREÇ VE YÖNTEM: 110 hastanın NAKT öncesi ve sonrası bilgisayarlı tomografi görüntülerinden iskelet kası, subkutan ve visseral yağ alan/indeksleri ölçülmüş; sağkalım Kaplan-Meier ve Cox regresyon, komplikasyon ilişkileri lojistik regresyon ile analiz edilmiştir. BULGULAR: Genel komplikasyon oranı %30,0, majör komplikasyon (Clavien-Dindo≥IIIa) %11,8; ortanca genel sağkalım 54 ay, 5 yıllık sağkalım %42,9 olarak saptanmıştır. Literatür kesim noktalarına (Martin, Fearon, Prado) göre tanımlanan statik sarkopeni, genel sağkalımla anlamlı bir ilişki göstermemiştir (tüm p>0,30). Buna karşılık, NAKT sürecindeki dinamik iskelet kası kaybı (ΔSMI%, ΔSMA%), evre, yaş, cinsiyet ve tümör grade'inden bağımsız olarak kötü sağkalımı öngörmüştür (düzeltilmiş HR: 0,94 ve 0,95; p=0,003 ve p=0,004); bu ilişki erkek, ≥65 yaş ve yüksek grade alt gruplarında da bağımsız olarak doğrulanmıştır. Sarkopenik visseral obezite fenotipi (düşük kas kütlesi + yüksek visseral yağ, n=26), majör komplikasyon riskiyle anlamlı ilişki göstermemiştir (düzeltilmiş OR: 2,37; p=0,237). NAKT sürecinde yalnızca iskelet kası anlamlı olarak azalırken hem subkutan hem visseral yağ dokusu korunmuştur. SONUÇ: Statik vücut kompozisyonu ölçümlerinin aksine, NAKT sürecindeki dinamik iskelet kası kaybı, mide kanserinde prognoz açısından evrelemeyi tamamlayıcı, klinik olarak değerli bir göstergedir; buna karşın literatür temelli statik sarkopeni tanımları ve sarkopenik visseral obezite gibi bileşik fenotipler, bu kohortta sağkalım veya postoperatif morbiditeyi bağımsız olarak öngörememiştir. Anahtar Kelimeler: gastrik adenokarsinom, vücut kompozisyon bozukluğu, neoadjuvan kemoterapi alan mide, sarkopeni, tümör kaşeksisi
