makaleler.baslik: Long-Term Effects of Biliopancreatic Diversion (BPD), Biliopancreatic Diversion with Duodenal Switch (BPD-DS), and Single Anastomosis Duodeno‑Ileal Bypass with Sleeve Gastrectomy (SADI‑S) in Patients with Obesity: A Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Obezitede BPD, BPD-DS ve SADI-S'nin Uzun Dönem Etkileri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2156 hastayı içeren 22 çalışmanın meta-analizinde BPD ve BPD-DS ile ortalama VKİ azalması 19,02 kg/m² oldu. RYGB'ye göre BPD/BPD-DS daha fazla VKİ düşüşü (fark 6,31 kg/m²) ve diyabet remisyonu sağladı (OR 3,49; %95 CI 1,11-10,91). Uzun dönemde revizyon cerrahisi %3, anemi %19 ve kemik sorunları %25 bulundu.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: The long-term outcomes of biliopancreatic diversion (BPD), BPD with duodenal switch (BPD-DS), and single anastomosis duodeno-ileal bypass with sleeve gastrectomy (SADI-S) in patients with obesity are not well established.
METHODS: A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science was conducted until October 11, 2025, following PRISMA guidelines. Studies reporting outcomes at ≥ 10 years following the specified procedures were included.
RESULTS: A total of 22 studies with 2156 patients were included. BPD and BPD-DS were associated with a mean BMI reduction of 19.02 kg/m². BPD-DS achieved total weight loss (TWL) of 36.34% and an excess weight loss (EWL) of 75.22%. Resolution rates for diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and obstructive sleep apnea were 78%, 63%, 83%, and 89%, respectively. Major long-term complications included revision surgery (3%), anemia (19%), iron deficiency (34%), and bone disorders (25%). Compared with RYGB, BPD and BPD-DS achieved greater BMI reduction (mean difference 6.31 kg/m², 95% CI: 3.16, 9.47) and higher diabetes resolution (OR 3.49, 95% CI: 1.11, 10.91), but with a higher rate of cholecystectomy. Diabetes relapse after BPD and BPD-DS occurred in 15% of patients, with significant reductions in fasting blood sugar and HbA1c. Limited data from two studies on SADI-S showed sustained weight loss (TWL 34.4%, EWL 80.4%) but notable rates of reoperation due to nutritional complications.
CONCLUSION: Overall, BPD and BPD-DS provide lasting weight loss and metabolic benefits, but careful patient selection and ongoing multidisciplinary care are important because of the risk of malnutrition. Long-term data on SADI-S appear promising but remain limited.

makaleler.baslik: Feasibility of a standardized three-dose intravenous tranexamic acid protocol in bariatric surgery: a pilot study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahide Standart Üç Doz İntravenöz Traneksamik Asit Protokolünün Uygulanabilirliği
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1077 bariatrik cerrahi hastasının prospektif çalışmasında, 3 doz intravenöz TXA protokolüne uyum %94,5 bulunmuştur. Klinik anlamlı kanama TXA döneminde %1,46, TXA dışı dönemde %2,84 saptanmıştır (p=0,174). Anastomozlu cerrahilerde kanama riski SG'ye göre daha yüksek bulunmuştur (OR 5,41; %95 CI 1,86-18,64; p=0,002).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Tranexamic acid (TXA) has been increasingly evaluated in bariatric surgery; however, heterogeneity remains in dosing and timing, and the feasibility of implementing a standardized multidose regimen in routine practice is not well established. This pilot study evaluated implementation of a standardized three-dose intravenous TXA protocol in metabolic bariatric surgery.
METHODS: This prospective, sequential-period pilot study included 1077 patients undergoing sleeve gastrectomy (SG), Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, or revisional surgery during alternating 3-month TXA and non-TXA periods. The primary outcome was feasibility, assessed by recruitment, protocol adherence, and completeness of 30-day outcome ascertainment. Postoperative bleeding, operative time (OT), length of stay (LOS), and thromboembolic events were evaluated exploratorily. Bleeding was assessed using Firth penalized logistic regression under intention-to-treat (ITT) and as-treated frameworks.
RESULTS: Of 1,122 patients screened, 1077 were enrolled (96.0%; 95% CI 94.7-97.1%). Overall adherence to period-assigned treatment was 94.5% (95% CI 93.0-95.8%); all patients initiating TXA completed the three-dose regimen, and 30-day outcome ascertainment was 100.0% (95% CI 99.7-100.0%). Clinically significant bleeding occurred in 1.46% of patients assigned to TXA periods vs. 2.84% assigned to non-TXA periods (p = 0.174). In ITT analysis, TXA allocation was not significantly associated with bleeding among SG patients (OR 0.55; 95% CI 0.10-2.53; p = 0.449), whereas anastomotic procedures had higher bleeding odds than SG (OR 5.41; 95% CI 1.86-18.64; p = 0.002). No treatment-by-procedure interaction was identified (p = 0.985). OT and LOS were similar between groups, and no 30-day thromboembolic events occurred.
CONCLUSION: Implementation of a standardized three-dose intravenous TXA protocol was feasible within routine bariatric surgical practice, with high adherence and complete outcome ascertainment. Given the low bleeding event rate observed in this pilot, adequately powered studies are needed to determine whether TXA meaningfully reduces postoperative bleeding and whether its effect differs by procedure type.

makaleler.baslik: Robotic Bariatric Surgery in Patients with BMI > 50 kg/m2 (Obesity V): A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: VKİ > 50 kg/m2 Hastalarda Robotik Bariatrik Cerrahi: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: VKİ > 50 kg/m2 olan 149.047 hastayı kapsayan 9 çalışmalık meta-analizde, robotik cerrahi ameliyat süresini anlamlı uzattı (MD 31,9 dk; p=0,032). Postoperatif komplikasyonlar (RR 1,3; p=0,6), reoperasyon (RR 0,9; p=0,8), açığa geçiş (RR 0,8; p=0,8) ve mortalite (RR 0,7; p=0,4) açısından laparoskopi ile robotik arasında fark bulunmadı.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Bariatric surgery poses a challenge in patients with BMI > 50 kg/m2. The current literature lacks sufficient data comparing robot-assisted and laparoscopy in this population. This systematic review aims to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of robotic bariatric surgery in patients with a BMI > 50 kg/m2.
METHODS: PubMed, Cochrane Central and EMBASE were searched for studies comparing robotically-assisted and laparoscopic bariatric surgery in patients with BMI > 50 kg/m2 from inception until May 2024. We included all robotic bariatric techniques as the intervention group. Studies lacking control groups or having overlapping populations were excluded. Our outcomes were mean operative time, postoperative and intraoperative complications, reoperation, conversion to open, surgical site infection, anastomotic leak, length of hospital stay (LOS), and mortality.
RESULTS: From 163 initial results, 9 studies comparing laparoscopy and robotic approaches were included in our final analysis. Our sample comprised 149.047 patients, of whom 10,761 (7.2%) were submitted to robotic surgery. The mean BMI of the population ranged from 53.4 to 65.9 kg/m2. The robot platform use significantly increased the operative time (MD = 31.9 minutes; 95% CI: 2.8; 61; P = .032). However, there were no statistically significant differences observed in: postoperative or intraoperative complications (RR = 1.3; 95% CI: 0.4; 4.1; P = .6) and RR = 0.4; 95% CI: 0.04; 4.46; P = .4); reoperation rates (RR = 0.9; 95% CI: 0.4; 1.9; P = .8); conversion to open (RR = 0.8; 95% CI: 0.2; 3.6; P = .8); surgical site infection (RR = 1.1; 95% CI: 0.8; 1.6; P = .5); anastomotic leak (RR = 0.9; 95% CI: 0.09; 9.1; P = .9); length of hospital stay (MD = -0.07; 95% CI: -0.6; 0.4; P = .7) and mortality (RR = 0.7; 95% CI: 0.3; 1.7; P = .4).
CONCLUSION: Our analysis supports the feasibility and safety of robotic platforms for bariatric procedures in patients with BMI > 50 kg/m2. Future prospective studies should prioritize investigating long-term outcomes and cost-effectiveness to enhance clinical decision-making for this patient demographic.

makaleler.baslik: Postoperative Complications Associated with Preoperative Hypoalbuminaemia in Gastrointestinal Surgery Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Gastrointestinal Cerrahide Preoperatif Hipoalbüminemi ve Postoperatif Komplikasyonlar: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 42 çalışmayı içeren meta-analizde gastrointestinal cerrahi hastalarında preoperatif hipoalbüminemi prevalansı %10,3 saptandı. Hipoalbüminemi; artmış 30 günlük mortalite (RR 3,37; %95 CI 2,59-4,37), tüm komplikasyonlar (RR 1,49), reoperasyon (RR 1,32) ve uzamış hastanede kalış süresi (3,02 gün artış) ile anlamlı şekilde ilişkiliydi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Gastrointestinal surgery is associated with significant postoperative morbidity. Serum albumin, an inexpensive biomarker that reflects nutritional reserve and systemic inflammation, may help identify at-risk patients. The prognostic value of hypoalbuminaemia in gastrointestinal surgery is not well defined. We aimed to evaluate the association between preoperative hypoalbuminaemia and postoperative outcomes in gastrointestinal surgery.
METHODS: We searched MEDLINE, Embase, and two Cochrane databases from inception to July 25, 2025 (PROSPERO: CRD420251130909) for studies comparing adverse outcomes between hypoalbuminaemic and normoalbuminaemic patients. Eligible studies reported at least one postoperative outcome.
RESULTS: Across 42 studies, the prevalence of preoperative hypoalbuminaemia was 10.3%, and was lower in bariatric surgery (5.5%) than in non-bariatric surgery populations (17.1%). In hypoalbuminaemic patients, 30-day mortality was more than three-fold higher (RR 3.37, 95% CI 2.59-4.37), all-cause complications were 49% higher (RR 1.49, 1.33-1.68), hospital length of stay was prolonged by 3.02 days (1.63-4.41), and readmission (RR 1.38, 1.22-1.57), reoperation (RR 1.32, 1.22-1.43), and non-home discharge (RR 1.51, 1.28-1.78) were significantly increased. Hypoalbuminaemia was associated with more cardiovascular (RR 1.75, 1.41-2.17), respiratory (RR 2.15, 1.79-2.58), infectious (RR 1.72, 1.47-2.01), and thromboembolic complications (RR 2.00, 1.76-2.27). Between-study heterogeneity was substantial, and prediction intervals were wide.
CONCLUSION: Preoperative hypoalbuminaemia is associated with increased mortality, morbidity, and healthcare utilisation in gastrointestinal surgery. As the primary associations derive from unadjusted observational data, preoperative albumin is best interpreted as a marker of perioperative risk rather than a proven modifiable target. Whether interventions that correct hypoalbuminaemia improve postoperative outcomes requires further research.

tez.baslik: Adli Tıp Kurumu Yedinci İhtisas Kurulunca hakkında mütalaa düzenlenen obezite cerrahisi vakalarının medikolegal değerlendirilmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Obezite Cerrahisi Olgularının Medikolegal ve Malpraktis Açısından Değerlendirilmesi
tez.kisa_ozet: 173 obezite cerrahisi dosyasının incelendiği adli tıp çalışmasında olguların %35,8'inde (62 hasta) malpraktis tespit edildi. En sık kusur endikasyon hatasıydı. Çok değişkenli analizde özel hastanede ameliyat edilme, açığa dönüş, majör komplikasyon ve VKİ malpraktis ile bağımsız ilişkili risk faktörleri olarak belirlendi.
tez.ozet: Bu çalışmada, Adli Tıp Kurumu 7. İhtisas Kurulu tarafından 2020–2024 yılları arasında hakkında mütalaa düzenlenen obezite cerrahisi olgularının medikolegal açıdan değerlendirilmesi ve malpraktis ile ilişkili faktörlerin belirlenmesi amaçlanmıştır. Retrospektif tanımlayıcı ve analitik nitelikteki bu çalışmada, Adli Tıp Kurumu 7. İhtisas Kurulu tarafından değerlendirilen obezite cerrahisine ilişkin dosyalar incelendi. Demografik özellikler, komorbiditeler, preoperatif değerlendirme süreçleri, cerrahi özellikler, komplikasyonlar, Clavien–Dindo komplikasyon sınıflaması ve malpraktis alt kategorileri kaydedildi. Malpraktis açısından yeterli değerlendirme yapılamayan olgular karşılaştırmalı analizlerden dışlandı. İstatistiksel değerlendirmede tanımlayıcı analizler, iki değişkenli karşılaştırmalar ve çok değişkenli lojistik regresyon analizleri kullanıldı. Toplam 198 olgu incelendi. Olguların 25'i (%12,6) hakkında yeterli değerlendirme yapılamadığından karşılaştırmalı analizler 173 olgudan oluşan ana analiz grubu üzerinden gerçekleştirildi. Ana analiz grubunda 111 olguda (%64,2) malpraktis saptanmazken, 62 olguda (%35,8) malpraktis tespit edildi. Malpraktis saptanan olgularda en sık kusur kategorisi endikasyon hataları olup bunu özen eksikliği, komplikasyon yönetimi eksikliği, cerrahi teknik hatalar ve konsültasyon eksiklikleri izledi. Çok değişkenli analizlerde özel hastanede opere edilme, açık veya laparoskopiden açığa dönüş cerrahi uygulanması, major komplikasyon varlığı ve Vücut kitle indeksinin malpraktis ile bağımsız ilişkili değişkenler olduğu belirlendi. Komplikasyon şiddeti arttıkça malpraktis görülme sıklığının da arttığı gözlendi. Obezite cerrahisine ilişkin medikolegal değerlendirmelerde belirleyici unsur yalnızca komplikasyon gelişimi değildir. Uygun hasta seçimi, doğru endikasyon belirlenmesi, multidisipliner değerlendirme süreçlerinin eksiksiz yürütülmesi, komplikasyonların zamanında tanınması ve etkin şekilde yönetilmesi ile tıbbi kayıtların yeterli düzeyde tutulması malpraktis riskinin değerlendirilmesinde önemli unsurlar olarak öne çıkmaktadır. Bu çalışma, Adli Tıp Kurumu 7. İhtisas Kurulu tarafından değerlendirilen obezite cerrahi olgularına ilişkin güncel medikolegal veriler sunarak literatüre katkı sağlamaktadır.

makaleler.baslik: De-escalation of Axillary Surgery in Early Breast Cancer: Translating SOUND and INSEMA into Clinical Practice.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Erken Evre Meme Kanserinde Aksiller Cerrahinin Azaltılması: Klinik Uygulama Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 437 hastanın prospektif takibinde, normal aksiller USG'si olan HR+/HER2- olguların %97'sinde SLNB güvenle atlanabilmiştir. Olguların %8'inde yüksek riskli patoloji saptanmış ve %3,2'sine sonradan SLNB uygulanmıştır (2 metastaz). 7,7 aylık median takipte aksiller nüks izlenmemiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To prospectively evaluate how often axillary staging can successfully be omitted in postmenopausal HR+/HER2- patients.
BACKGROUND: Three randomized trials showed no difference in recurrence or survival outcomes with omission of sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) in cT1-T2N0 patients with a negative axillary ultrasound (AUS) undergoing breast-conserving surgery (BCS). We prospectively evaluated applicability of this approach.
METHODS: From 3/1/24 to 9/1/25, SLNB was omitted in postmenopausal women age 50-70 years with unicentric or multifocal, clinical stage 1, grade 1/2, HR+/HER2- cancers and a normal AUS undergoing BCS. After the results of INSEMA were reported, tumors up to 2.5 cm were included. Patients with pathology showing grade 3, T≥3 cm, or HR- or HER2+ underwent multidisciplinary discussion regarding the need for SLNB.
RESULTS: In 437 patients with 442 cancers, the median patient age was 63 years, median mammographic tumor size was 0.9 cm, and 74% were grade 2. A total of 34 patients (8%) had high-risk features on final pathology (grade 3, n=20; T≥3 cm, n=11; HER2+, n=3) and 14 (3.2%) had SLNB. Of these, 2 had SLN metastases. A total of 96% of patients received radiotherapy (40% whole breast, 56% partial breast), 415 (95%) received adjuvant endocrine therapy, and 31 (7%) received chemotherapy. At 7.7-month median follow-up, there have been no axillary recurrences.
CONCLUSION: Adoption of the SOUND, INSEMA, and BOOG 13-08 data allowed omission of SLNB in 97% of postmenopausal patients age ≤70 years with cT1-2N0, grade 1/2, HR+/HER2- cancers and a normal AUS, reducing the burden of treatment.

makaleler.baslik: Effectiveness of Closed-Incision Negative Pressure Wound Therapy in Non-Autologous Breast Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Otojen Olmayan Meme Cerrahisinde Kapalı Kesi Negatif Basınçlı Yara Tedavisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2.287 hasta ve 3.376 memeyi kapsayan 20 çalışmanın meta-analizinde ciNPWT, standart pansumana göre toplam yara komplikasyonlarını %31,8'den %17,8'e (%14 mutlak risk azalması; RR 0,56; p<0,0001), yara ayrışmasını (RR 0,48; p=0,0037) ve nekrozu (RR 0,67; p=0,0187) anlamlı derecede azaltmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Prophylactic closed-incision negative pressure wound therapy (ciNPWT) may reduce risk of postoperative wound complications, but its use in breast surgery remains uncertain due to lack of breast-specific recommendations in guidelines. This meta-analysis addresses this gap by evaluating the efficacy of ciNPWT versus standard dressings in non-autologous breast surgery.
METHODS: A meta-analysis of RCTs and observational studies comparing ciNPWT versus standard dressings in patients undergoing mastectomy, implant-based breast reconstruction, or mammoplasty was conducted following PRISMA (from inception to September 2025). Outcomes were total wound complications, surgical site infection, wound dehiscence, necrosis, seroma, haematoma, re-operation, and implant loss. Risk of bias (RoB2, ROBINS-I) and certainty (GRADE) were assessed, and data pooled (RStudio). Registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251002005).
RESULTS: Twenty studies (6 RCTs, 14 observational) involving 2287 patients (3376 breasts) were included. ciNPWT significantly reduced total wound complications (RR 0.56, 95%CI 0.42-0.74; p<0.0001; I²=71.9%; moderate certainty), corresponding to an absolute risk reduction (ARR) of 14% (31.8% to 17.8%). Wound dehiscence (RR 0.48, 95%CI 0.29-0.79; p=0.0037; I²=33.4%) and necrosis (RR 0.67, 95%CI 0.48-0.94; p=0.0187; I²=7.5%) were also significantly reduced. Subgroup analyses suggested stronger effects in BMI ≥30 (RR 0.41 vs 0.61 for BMI <30) and with -125 mmHg settings (RR 0.46 vs 0.65 for -80 mmHg), though differences were not statistically significant (p>0.20).
CONCLUSION: Moderate-certainty evidence indicates that ciNPWT reduces postoperative wound complications-particularly dehiscence and necrosis-with a clinically meaningful ARR of 14% for total wound complications. Refining patient selection and device configuration may further enhance its applicability.

makaleler.baslik: Role of Topical Nitroglycerin in Prevention and Management of Post-mastectomy Skin Flap Necrosis: A Prospective Randomized Controlled Study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Mastektomi Sonrası Flep Nekrozunun Önlenmesinde Topikal Nitrogliserin Kullanımı: RCT
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Modifiye radikal mastektomi yapılan 60 hastanın yer aldığı RCT'de, topikal %2 nitrogliserin grubunda cilt flep nekrozu %6,7 (2/30) iken kontrol grubunda %33,3 (10/30) bulunmuştur. Nitrogliserin ile yara iyileşmesi anlamlı derecede hızlanmış ve cerrahi debridman gereksinimi azalmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Mastectomy skin flap necrosis is a common postoperative complication following breast cancer surgery and is associated with delayed wound healing, increased morbidity, prolonged hospital stay, additional surgical procedures, and delayed initiation of adjuvant therapy. Impaired flap perfusion is considered the primary underlying mechanism. Topical nitroglycerin, through nitric oxide-mediated vasodilation, has been proposed as a simple and cost-effective method to improve flap vascularity and reduce ischemic complications. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of topical nitroglycerin in preventing and reducing post-mastectomy skin flap necrosis.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A prospective, randomized, assessor-blinded, controlled study was conducted on 60 patients undergoing modified radical mastectomy (MRM). Patients were randomly allocated into two groups of 30 each. The intervention group received topical 2% nitroglycerin ointment, while the control group received topical povidone-iodine ointment. The primary outcome was the incidence of skin flap necrosis. Secondary outcomes included wound healing time, delayed wound healing, surgical site infection, debridement requirement, hospital stay, severity of flap necrosis, and treatment-related adverse events.
RESULTS: Skin flap necrosis occurred in two (6.7%) patients in the nitroglycerin group compared with 10 (33.3%) patients in the control group. Patients receiving nitroglycerin demonstrated significantly faster wound healing, lower rates of delayed wound healing, and reduced requirement for surgical debridement. Full-thickness flap necrosis occurred only in the control group, and the mean necrotic area was significantly smaller among patients treated with nitroglycerin. Although surgical site infection and hospital stay were lower in the nitroglycerin group, these differences were not statistically significant. Adverse events were mild and self-limiting, with no treatment discontinuations.
CONCLUSION: Topical nitroglycerin is a safe and effective adjunct for reducing post-mastectomy skin flap necrosis and improving wound healing outcomes. Its routine use may improve postoperative recovery and reduce flap-related complications following MRM.

makaleler.baslik: Comparison of Modified Pectoral Nerve Block and Erector Spinae Plane Block for Postoperative Analgesia and Surgical Stress Response Following Modified Radical Mastectomy: A Prospective, Randomised, Blinded Study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Mastektomide PECS-II ve Erektör Spina Bloklarının Postoperatif Analjezi Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: MRM uygulanan 42 hastayı içeren randomize prospektif çalışmada, PECS-II grubunda ilk kurtarma analjeziği ihtiyacı ESPB grubuna göre anlamlı derecede daha uzun bulundu (9,05±1,12 saate karşı 6,95±1,16 saat; p<0,001). 24 saatlik analjezik tüketimi, 6. saatteki ağrı skorları, stres yanıtı belirteçleri ve hasta memnuniyeti PECS-II ile daha üstün saptandı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Erector spinae plane block (ESPB) and modified pectoral nerve block (PECS-II) are being increasingly used to control pain following breast surgeries. However, evidence comparing their effects on postoperative analgesia and surgical stress response is limited. The current study compared analgesic efficacy and surgical stress response attenuation of ESPB and PECS-II in patients undergoing modified radical mastectomy (MRM).
METHODS: In this prospective, randomised, comparative study, 42 patients undergoing elective MRM were randomly divided to receive either ESPB or PECS-II. Both groups received 30 mL of 0.2% ropivacaine with 0.5 μg/kg dexmedetomidine after induction of general anaesthesia (GA). The primary outcome was time to first rescue analgesia requirement. Secondary outcomes were postoperative numerical rating scale (NRS) scores, rescue analgesic consumption, intraoperative fentanyl requirement, serum cortisol, interleukin-6 (IL-6) and neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), patient satisfaction and block-related complications.
RESULTS: The mean time to first rescue analgesia was significantly larger in the PECS-II group than in the ESPB group (9.05 ± 1.12 h vs 6.95 ± 1.16 h; p < 0.001). Patients receiving PECS-II had lower 24-h diclofenac (114.3 ± 38.4 mg vs 146.4 ± 16.4 mg; p = 0.002) and tramadol consumption (7.1 ± 17.9 mg vs 23.8 ± 25.6 mg; p = 0.021). NRS scores were lower in the PECS-II group at 6 h postoperatively (p < 0.001). Intraoperative fentanyl requirement was comparable between the two groups (p = 0.133). Postoperative serum cortisol (363.48 ± 41.79 vs 495.95 ± 52.20 nmol/L), IL-6 (14.48 ± 4.39 vs 24.43 ± 6.33 pg/mL) and NLR (4.15 ± 0.55 vs 4.98 ± 0.85) were also lower in the PECS-II group (p ≤ 0.001). Patient satisfaction scores were higher following PECS-II (5.62 ± 0.74 vs 5.05 ± 0.67; p = 0.022). No block-related complications were observed in either group.
CONCLUSION: PECS-II provided longer postoperative analgesia than ESPB in patients undergoing MRM under GA. Exploratory analyses showed lower postoperative analgesic consumption, lower pain scores at 6 h, lower postoperative stress response markers and higher patient satisfaction with PECS-II. These secondary findings should be considered hypothesis-generating and warrant confirmation in larger, adequately powered studies. Intraoperative fentanyl requirement was comparable between the two groups.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: Clinical Trials Registry: CTRI/2024/04/066198.

makaleler.baslik: BRCA Mutation Carriers and Breast Implant-Associated Anaplastic Large-Cell Lymphoma: Accumulating Evidence, Proposed Mechanism, and Implications for Reconstructive Planning and Follow-Up.
makaleler.baslik_tr: BRCA Taşıyıcılarında Meme İmplantı İlişkili ALCL ve Rekonstrüksiyon Planlaması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: BRCA1/2 ve TP53 germline mutasyonlarının implant ilişkili anaplastik büyük hücreli lenfoma (BIA-ALCL) riskini artırdığını gösteren kanıtları derleyen çalışmada, BRCA1/2 taşıyıcılarında yaşa göre düzeltilmiş riskin 16 kat yüksek olduğu bildirilmiştir (%95 CI 3,6-76,1). BRCA taşıyıcılarında dokulu implantlardan kaçınılması önerilmektedir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Breast implant-associated anaplastic large-cell lymphoma (BIA-ALCL) is an uncommon cluster of differentiation (CD)-30-positive T-cell lymphoma arising in the peri-implant capsule that was recognized as a definitive entity by the World Health Organization (WHO) in its 2022 fifth edition. Although historically framed as a device complication of textured implant surfaces, recent evidence suggests that germline mutations in BRCA1, BRCA2, and TP53 confer independent host-level susceptibility. These findings have yet to be synthesized for the surgical oncology audience.
METHODS: This was a narrative review adhering to Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles (SANRA) criteria. PubMed and MEDLINE were searched from January 2000 through March 2026. Evidence was ranked using the 2011 Oxford Centre for Evidence-Based Medicine levels of evidence.
DISCUSSION: Four evidence streams spanning 15 years have consistently associated germline BRCA1/2 and TP53 mutations with elevated BIA-ALCL risk. The 2025 Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center prospective cohort reported a 16-fold increased age-adjusted risk in BRCA1/2 carriers (95% confidence interval 3.6-76.1). Compressed disease latency has been observed in mutation carriers. Overall, these reports suggest a gene-environment interaction model where impaired homologous recombination repair lowers the threshold for clonal T-lymphocyte expansion in the chronic inflammatory peri-implant microenvironment. Autologous reconstruction eliminates the BIA-ALCL risk. Thus, both autologous and smooth implant-based reconstruction should be explicitly discussed with BRCA carriers, and textured devices should be avoided if implant-based reconstruction is chosen. Surveillance strategies, including explicit documentation, earlier investigation thresholds, and structured long-term handoff, are recommended.
CONCLUSIONS: The evidence is observational and not yet sufficient for prescriptive guidelines but is consistent, biologically coherent, and of sufficient magnitude to warrant a measured adjustment in reconstructive counseling, implant selection, and follow-up in BRCA mutation carriers.

tez.baslik: Meme kanseri tanılı olan hastalarda Ki-67 ekspresyonun aksiller lenf nodları tutulumuyla ilişkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Meme Kanserinde Preoperatif Ki-67 Düzeyinin Aksiller Lenf Nodu Tutulumuyla İlişkisi
tez.kisa_ozet: Klinik ve radyolojik olarak aksilla negatif 246 meme kanseri hastasının incelendiği retrospektif kesitsel çalışmada, hastaların %6,9'unda (n=17) aksiller lenf nodu tutulumu saptanmıştır. Aksiller tutulumu olmayanlarda preoperatif Ki-67 medyan değeri %20 bulunmuş; preoperatif ve postoperatif Ki-67 düzeyleri arasında anlamlı fark gözlenmiştir (p=0,007).
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışma, meme kanseri olan hastalarda klinik ve radyolojik olarak aksiller lenf nodu negatif, preoperatif biyopsi sonucunda elde edilen yüksek Ki-67 ekspresyonu olan hastalarda aksiller diseksiyon gerekip gerekmediğini ortaya koymak, takip ve tedavi için sadece sentinel lenf nodu biyopsi veya hedeflenmiş lenf nodu diseksiyonu yeterli olup olmadığını ön plana çıkartmak ve aksillaya yönelik daha geniş cerrahi girişimlerin önlenebilirliği amaçlanmıştır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Çalışmamız, Sağlık Bilimleri Üniversitesi Bursa Yüksek İhtisas Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi Klinik Araştırmalar Etik kurulu 20.11.2024 tarihli ve 2024-TBEK2024|11-13 kararı ile onaylanması sonrası retrospektif kesitsel çalışma tasarımına uygun olarak planlanmıştır. Ocak 2020–Aralık 2024 tarihleri arasında Genel Kliniği'ne memede kitle şikâyeti ile başvuran ve sonrasında opere edilen 580 hastanın verileri retrospektif olarak incelemeye alındı. Çalışmaya alınan hastaların yaşı, komorbid hastalıkları, preoperatif görüntülemeleri, patolojik tanı, aksiller lenf nodu tutulumu, primer sistemik tedavi alıp almadığı, preoperatif ve postoperatif Ki-67 ekspresyon indeksi, Östrojen reseptörü (ER), Progesteron reseptörü (PR), CERB-2 ve Triple negatiflik statüleri, meme ve aksillaya yönelik yapılan cerrahi prosedürleri, postoperatif patolojik tanı ve aksiller lenf nodu sayısı ve karakteristiği, aksiller cerrahi kapsamında lenf nodu haritalaması amacıyla metilen mavisi (Methylene Blue) boyama yöntemi kullanılan hastalar çalışmaya dahil edildi. Klinik ve radyolojik olarak aksiller lenf nodu pozitif, preoperatif veya postoperatif Ki-67 çalışılmamış, postoperatif patoloji tanısında tam yanıtlı meme kanseri olan hastalar çalışma dışına alındı. Bu değerlendirme sonucunda kriterlere uygun 246 hasta çalışmaya dahil edildi. Preoperatif Ki-67 proliferasyon indeksi ile aksillaya yönelik yapılan cerrahi prosedürün boyutu ve bu durumu etkileyen faktörler retrospektif kesitsel inceleme sonuçları karşılaştırılarak incelendi. Bulgular: Çalışmaya meme kanseri tanısı nedeniyle ameliyat edilen toplam 246 hasta dahil edildi. Çalışmaya dahil edilen 246 hastanın yaş ortalaması 58.7 ± 12,5 yıl (minimum: 28, maksimum: 86) idi. Hastaların %98,8'i (n=243) kadın, %1,2'si (n=3) ise erkekti. Bu hastaların %6,9'i (n=17) aksiller lenf nodu tutulumu gösterirken, %93,1'i (n=229) aksiller lenf nodu tutulumu göstermemişti. Aksiller lenf nodu tutulumu olmayan hastalarda preoperatif Ki-67 ekspresyon düzeyinin medyan değeri %20 (%2 – %100) iken, postoperatif dönemde medyan değer %20 (%1 – %95) idi. Preoperatif ve postoperatif dönemler arasında Ki-67 ekspresyon düzeyinin farklılık gösterdiği saptanmış olup (p = 0.007), postoperatif dönemde Ki-67 ekspresyon düzeyinin daha düşük olduğu gözlendi. Hastaların preoperatif patolojileri, saptanan Ki-67 ekspresyonun aksiller cerrahiye etkisi ve nihai patolojideki Ki-67 ekspresyonuyla aksiller lenf nodları değerlendirildi. Sonuç: Preoperatif Ki-67 düzeyi, klinik olarak aksilla negatif meme kanseri hastalarında cerrahi tedavi planlamasında önemli bir belirleyici faktördür. Yüksek Ki-67 ekspresyonu, daha geniş aksiller cerrahi ile ilişkili olmakla birlikte, primer sistemik tedaviye yanıt potansiyeli göz önünde bulundurulmalı ve Ki-67'nin, prognostik rolünün yanı sıra aksiller cerrahinin kapsamını belirlemede prediktif bir parametre olarak kullanılması, gereksiz morbiditenin önlenmesine katkı sağlayabilir. Bu bulgular, aksiller cerrahi tedavi planlaması yapılırken dikkate alınmalıdır. Ancak, bu konuda daha geniş klinik çalışmalara ihtiyaç vardır.

makaleler.baslik: Early structured rehabilitation following open retromuscular incisional hernia repair: a prospective randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Açık Retromüsküler Kesi Fıtığı Onarımı Sonrası Erken Yapılandırılmış Rehabilitasyon: RCT
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Açık Rives-Stoppa onarımı yapılan 30 hastalık prospektif RCT'de, 3. haftada başlayan yapılandırılmış rehabilitasyon 90°/s gövde fleksör torkunda anlamlı artış sağladı (Δ +34,3'e karşı -3,8 N·m; p=0,023). Komplikasyonlarda artış görülmedi; 12 aylık takipte 2 nüks kontrol grubunda izlendi.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Incisional hernias remain a common postoperative problem for general surgeons. In recent years, early postoperative rehabilitation has gained increasing attention as a potential strategy to enhance recovery following abdominal wall reconstruction. This study aimed to evaluate whether structured early postoperative rehabilitation improves objectively measured abdominal wall and trunk muscle functional recovery after open retromuscular (Rives-Stoppa) incisional hernia repair while maintaining postoperative safety.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Thirty adults undergoing elective open retromuscular (Rives-Stoppa) repair of European Hernia Society W2 incisional hernias were randomized to structured postoperative rehabilitation (n = 15) or standard postoperative care (n = 15). Baseline and approximately 2-month postoperative trunk muscle performance were assessed using Biodex dynamometry. The rehabilitation program consisted of supervised, progressive exercises initiated at postoperative week 3 and delivered according to the standardized study protocol. The primary analyses compared individual patient-level changes in trunk flexor and extensor peak torque between groups at angular velocities of 60°/s and 90°/s using the Mann-Whitney U test. Secondary outcomes included additional dynamometric parameters and postoperative clinical outcomes.
RESULTS: Thirty patients were included in the analysis. Between-group comparisons demonstrated a statistically significant difference only for the change in trunk flexor peak torque at 90°/s, favoring the rehabilitation group (Δ + 34.3 vs. - 3.8 N·m; Mann-Whitney U = 80.0, p = 0.023). Between-group differences were not statistically significant for trunk flexor peak torque at 60°/s (p = 0.081), trunk extensor peak torque at 60°/s (p = 0.224), or trunk extensor peak torque at 90°/s (p = 0.254). Because four primary peak-torque comparisons were performed without adjustment for multiplicity, the isolated statistically significant finding should be interpreted cautiously. No apparent increase in postoperative complications was observed in the rehabilitation group. Two recurrences occurred during the 12-month follow-up, both in the control group. However, the study was not powered to evaluate recurrence.
CONCLUSIONS: Structured early postoperative rehabilitation was associated with a greater improvement in trunk flexor peak torque at 90°/s compared with standard postoperative care. No statistically significant between-group differences were observed for the other assessed peak-torque outcomes. Given the small sample size, baseline imbalances, multiple unadjusted comparisons, and effort-dependent nature of dynamometric testing, the findings should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating. Larger adequately powered randomized trials incorporating patient-centered outcomes are required.

makaleler.baslik: Percutaneous endoscopic sigmoidopexy for recurrent sigmoid volvulus in high-risk adults: a systematic review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yüksek Riskli Erişkinlerde Nüks Sigmoid Volvulus İçin Perkütan Endoskopik Sigmoidopeksi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 9 çalışmayı ve 25 hastayı içeren sistematik derlemede, tüpsüz perkütan endoskopik sigmoidopeksinin (PES) teknik başarısı %100, nüks oranı 1/25 (%4) ve işleme bağlı mortalite 1/25 (%4) bulundu. Takipte tüm nedenlere bağlı mortalite 7/25 (%28) idi. Cerrahi riski yüksek hastalarda PES tüpsüz ve minimal invaziv bir alternatif sunmaktadır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Recurrent sigmoid volvulus in frail, comorbid adults recurs frequently after detorsion and carries significant risks with resectional surgery. Percutaneous endoscopic sigmoidopexy (PES), defined as fixation of the sigmoid colon to the abdominal wall without an indwelling tube, has been proposed as a tube-free, minimally invasive alternative.
OBJECTIVE: To synthesise outcomes of strict PES (fixation-only; no tube) for recurrent sigmoid volvulus in adults at high surgical risk.
METHODS: PRISMA-guided review (2000-31 July 2025) registered prospectively with PROSPERO CRD420251111664. MEDLINE, Embase, PubMed, and Cochrane were searched. Inclusion: adults with recurrent sigmoid volvulus managed by PES using T-fasteners, anchor devices, sutures, or clips without a tube. Exclusion: tube-based percutaneous endoscopic colostomy (PEC), open/laparoscopic pexy, colectomy, paediatric/pregnancy cases, non-volvulus pathology. Dual screening/extraction; JBI case report/series appraisal; narrative certainty assessment. Primary outcomes: technical success, recurrence, procedure-related mortality, all-cause mortality. Proportions are reported with Wilson 95% confidence intervals.
RESULTS: Nine reports (2001-2025) including 25 patients met strict PES criteria. Patients were elderly and generally ASA III-IV where stated. Technical success was 100%. Recurrent volvulus occurred in 1/25 (4%); procedure-related mortality was 1/25 (4%); all-cause mortality during follow-up was 7/25 (28%). Complications were mostly minor (pneumoperitoneum, subcutaneous/surgical emphysema, superficial infection); one small-bowel obstruction (internal herniation) resolved by releasing sutures. Follow-up was heterogeneous (median 7.5 months; range 1-44). Evidence certainty is very low.
CONCLUSIONS: In carefully selected high-risk adults with recurrent sigmoid volvulus, strict PES appears feasible with high technical success, low recurrence, and low procedure-related mortality while avoiding an indwelling tube. Prospective, standardised, multicentre research with ≥12-month follow-up is warranted.

makaleler.baslik: Selective use of reinforced tissue matrix in complex abdominal wall reconstruction: a multicenter consensus analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kompleks Karın Duvarı Rekonstrüksiyonunda Güçlendirilmiş Doku Matriksinin Seçici Kullanımı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: RTM meş uygulanan 74 kompleks karın duvarı hastasında cerrahi alan enfeksiyonu %20,3, meş enfeksiyonu %7,8 ve nüks %12,3 saptandı. 7 cerrahın bağımsız değerlendirmesinde kontamine ve geniş defektli vakaların %50'sinde RTM kullanımı için uzlaşı sağlandı (κ=0,34). Rutin kullanım desteklenmedi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Optimal mesh selection in complex abdominal wall reconstruction remains controversial, particularly in contaminated fields or in patients with extensive tissue loss. Reinforced tissue matrix (RTM) meshes combine biologic material with permanent synthetic reinforcement and may represent a potential option in selected cases. This study aimed to analyze clinical use patterns of RTM meshes and identify potential indication niches through structured expert consensus.
METHODS: A multicenter expert panel collected cases of abdominal wall reconstruction using RTM mesh (OviTex). Patient characteristics, hernia features, operative strategies, and postoperative outcomes were recorded in a standardized database. Cases were evaluated according to established complexity criteria. Seven abdominal wall surgeons independently rated the appropriateness of RTM use. Consensus was defined as ≥70% agreement, and interrater reliability was assessed using Fleiss' kappa.
RESULTS: Seventy-four patients were included (mean age 63.9 ± 12.0 years; median BMI 30.2 kg/m2). Most patients presented with incisional hernias and large fascial defects. Contaminated or potentially contaminated operative fields were present in approximately one-third of cases. Surgical site infection occurred in 20.3%, mesh infection in 7.8%, and hernia recurrence in 12.3%. Expert consensus supporting RTM implantation was reached in 50% of cases, particularly in scenarios combining contamination with large fascial defects. Interrater agreement was fair (κ = 0.34).
CONCLUSION: Routine use of RTM meshes in abdominal wall reconstruction is not supported. However, RTM may represent a potential option in selected high-complexity scenarios involving contamination and large fascial defects where permanent synthetic meshes may be unsuitable. These findings are exploratory and hypothesis-generating and may support future Delphi-based indication consensus development.

makaleler.baslik: Reconstructive Strategies for Abdominal Wall Defects in Patients With Stomas: A Systematic Review of Mesh and Flap Techniques.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Stomalı Hastalarda Karın Duvarı Defektleri İçin Rekonstrüktif Stratejiler: Sistematik Derleme
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 13 çalışmayı içeren sistematik derlemede, stomalı hastalarda meş ve flep teknikleri değerlendirildi. Meş desteğinin parastomal herni gelişimini azalttığı, geniş defekt veya nükslerde flep ve komponent ayrıştırma tekniklerinin etkili olduğu saptandı. SMART ve STORRM yöntemlerinin düşük nüks oranlarıyla uygulanabilir olduğu bildirildi.
makaleler.ozet: An abdominal wall hernia occurs when there is a defect or weakness in the abdominal wall musculofascial layer. Patients with ostomies are at particular risk of developing parastomal hernia because stoma creation necessarily traverses the abdominal wall, creating a structural weak point. In high-risk patients, including those with prior abdominal surgery, prior mesh infection, recurrent parastomal hernia, or large soft-tissue defects, hernia repair often requires complex reconstruction. Mesh-based repairs reduce hernia recurrence rates; however, limitations persist in settings of infected mesh fields, recurrent parastomal hernias, or extensive soft-tissue defects requiring tissue coverage beyond mesh reinforcement alone. This systematic review evaluates reconstructive approaches for abdominal wall defects in stoma patients, comparing mesh-only versus mesh with flap repairs, focusing on hernia recurrence, wound healing, and infection outcomes. Following PRISMA guidelines, comprehensive searches of PubMed, ScienceDirect, and the Cochrane Library were undertaken to identify studies published between January 2015 and July 2025. Boolean operators and Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) terms combining 'stoma,' 'abdominal wall,' and 'reconstruction' yielded 1,947 articles. After duplicate removal, 1,785 unique records were screened. Eligible studies included randomized controlled trials (RCTs), observational studies, and case series with at least five patients, reporting outcomes of mesh with or without flap reconstruction in adult patients undergoing abdominal wall repair in the setting of a stoma, which encompasses parastomal hernia repair, wound breakdown, and complex abdominal wall reconstruction with concomitant stoma management. Exclusions included case reports, reviews, pediatric-only, and abstract-only studies. Screening and data extraction were performed independently by two reviewers, with discrepancies resolved by consensus. Thirteen papers met inclusion criteria. The PRISMA 2020 flow diagram documented study selection. Included studies comprised retrospective cohorts, case-controlled analyses, and database studies (sample sizes up to 9,000 patients). Patients frequently had malignancy, obesity, prior abdominal surgery, or prior mesh infection as risk factors. Mesh reinforcement, whether prophylactic or used in delayed reconstruction, consistently reduced parastomal hernia incidence. Flap reconstructions, including autologous tissue flaps and component separation, were effective in complex cases involving large defects or recurrent hernias. Techniques such as Stapled Mesh Stoma Reinforcement Technique (SMART) and Stapled Transabdominal Ostomy Reinforcement with Retromuscular Mesh (STORRM) demonstrated feasibility with low recurrence rates in high-risk patients. Both mesh-only and combined mesh-flap approaches demonstrated low complication rates and preserved stoma function, supporting their safety and effectiveness in appropriately selected patients. Both mesh-only and mesh-plus-flap reconstruction are effective and safe for abdominal wall defect repair in stoma patients. Mesh reinforcement reduces hernia recurrence, while flap techniques offer added benefit in complex cases characterized by large defects, recurrent parastomal hernias, or compromised tissue. Well-powered, prospective comparative studies are needed to establish definitive evidence-based guidelines.

makaleler.baslik: Surgeon task load, ergonomics, and clinical outcomes in laparoscopic versus robotic-assisted inguinal hernia repair: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik ve Robotik İnguinal Herni Onarımının Karşılaştırmalı Meta-Analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Toplam 482 hastayı içeren 4 RCT'nin meta-analizinde, robotik ve laparoskopik inguinal herni onarımı arasında cerrahi süre (MD 17,14; %95 CI -3,22 ila 37,49) ve iş yükü (MD -4,50; %95 CI -16,78 ila 7,78) benzer bulunmuştur. Postoperatif komplikasyon oranları açısından da yöntemler arasında anlamlı bir fark saptanmamıştır (OR 0,89; %95 CI 0,42-1,90).
makaleler.ozet: Conventional laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair (LIHR) is common and robotic-assisted techniques (RIHR) are increasingly being implemented. Current literature is indecisive on whether RIHR offers clinical and ergonomical benefits. This systematic review compares LIHR and RIHR specifically focusing on surgeon workload and ergonomics. A literature search was performed in four databases to find randomized controlled trials comparing RIHR and LIHR. A risk of bias assessment was conducted using the Cochrane Tool and results were synthesized as pooled estimate, odds ratio or narrative review. Four trials were identified, encompassing 482 patients. The groups showed similar baseline characteristics across studies. A broad range of surgeon experience could be observed between trials. All studies showed a significant difference in operative time, but while three studies found RIHR to take longer, one study reported shorter operative time with RIHR, altogether leading to a non-significant pooled estimate (MD 17.14; 95% CI -3.22 to 37.49). While one study showed significantly better ergonomics with RIHR, the other study reporting on that topic found ergonomics between the two approaches to be comparable. Surgeon task load varied substantially between the trials. The pooled estimate slightly favored RIHR but did not reach statistical significance (MD -4.50; 95% CI -16.78 to 7.78). Postoperative complication rate was not significantly different overall (OR 0.89, 95% CI 0.42 to 1.90), although one study reported significantly less complications after RIHR. RIHR shows comparable patient-centered outcomes to LIHR. At the moment, there is no evidence for significant benefits regarding task load and ergonomics.

tez.baslik_tr: Strangüle Hernilerde Bağırsak Rezeksiyonunu Öngören Preoperatif Laboratuvar Belirteçleri
tez.kisa_ozet: İnkarsere strangüle herni nedeniyle acil ameliyat edilen 124 hastanın retrospektif incelenmesinde, hastaların 29'una (%23,4) bağırsak rezeksiyonu yapılmıştır. Çok değişkenli analizde NLO (OR 1,27; %95 GA 1,13-1,43; p<0,001) ve CRP (OR 1,014; %95 GA 1,004-1,024; p=0,004) rezeksiyon gereksinimini öngörmede bağımsız prediktif faktörler olarak belirlenmiştir.
tez.ozet: ÖZET Strangüle Hernilerde Rezeksiyon İçin Prediktif Laboratuvar Değerleri Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı, inkarsere strangüle herni nedeniyle opere edilen hastalarda bağırsak rezeksiyonu gereksinimini öngörebilecek laboratuvar parametrelerini belirlemek ve bu parametrelerin tanısal performanslarını değerlendirmektir. Çalışmanın Tasarımı:Retrospektif tanımlayıcı çalışma Çalışmanın süresi ve yeri: Ocak 2016-Ocak 2026,İzmir Katip Çelebi Üniversitesi Atatürk Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniği Gereç ve Yöntem: Bu retrospektif çalışmaya, inkarsere strangüle herni tanısıyla Ocak 2016 ve Ocak 2026 arasında acil olarak opere edilen 124 hasta dahil edildi. Hastalar operasyon sırasında bağırsak rezeksiyonu yapılan ve yapılmayan olmak üzere iki gruba ayrıldı. Hastaların yaş, cinsiyet, beyaz küre sayısı (WBC), nötrofil sayısı, lenfosit sayısı, C-reaktif protein (CRP) düzeyleri,Sistemik İmmün İnflamatuar İndeks(SII) ve Nötrofil/Lenfosit Oranı (NLO) değerlendirildi. Bu iki grubun arasındaki karşılaştırmalarda uygun istatistiksel testler kullanıldı. Laboratuvar parametrelerinin rezeksiyon gereksinimini öngörmedeki performansları ROC analizi ile değerlendirildi. Bağımsız prediktif faktörlerin belirlenmesi amacıyla tek değişkenli ve çok değişkenli lojistik regresyon analizleri uygulandı. Bulgular: Çalışmaya dahil edilen 124 hastanın 29'unda (%23,4) bağırsak rezeksiyonu uygulanırken, 95'inde (%76,6) rezeksiyon uygulanmasına ihtiyaç duyulmamıştır. Rezeksiyon yapılan hastalarda yapılan acil serviste yapılan pre-operatif tetkiklerde WBC, nötrofil sayısı, CRP,SII ve NLO değerleri anlamlı derecede yüksek bulundu (p<0,05). ROC analizinde NLO'nın rezeksiyon gereksinimini öngörmede en yüksek tanısal performansa sahip olduğu saptandı (AUC=0,945; %95 GA: 0,901–0,981). NLO için belirlenen ≥8,20 eşik değerinde duyarlılık %96,6 ve özgüllük %89,5 olarak hesaplandı. CRP için AUC değeri 0,858 olarak bulunurken, SII'nin de bağırsak rezeksiyonu gereksinimini öngörmede istatistiksel olarak anlamlı olduğu saptandı (AUC=0,658; %95 GA: 0,546–0,770). Bununla birlikte SII'nin tanısal performansı NLO ve CRP'ye göre daha düşük bulundu Çok değişkenli lojistik regresyon analizinde NLO (OR=1,27; %95 GA: 1,13–1,43; p<0,001) ve CRP (OR=1,014; %95 GA: 1,004–1,024; p=0,004) bağımsız prediktif faktörler olduğu belirlenirken SII ve WBC'nin ise çok değişkenli analizde anlamlılığını kaybettiği tespit edildi. Sonuç: İnkarsere strangüle herni nedeniyle opere edilen hastalarda preoperatif tetkiklerde NLO ve CRP düzeyleri bağırsak rezeksiyonu gereksinimini öngörmede bağımsız prediktif faktörlerdir. Özellikle NLO'nın yüksek duyarlılık, özgüllük ve ayırt edici güce sahip olması nedeniyle klinik uygulamada kullanılabilecek kolay ulaşılabilir ve düşük maliyetli bir biyobelirteç olduğu düşünülmektedir. Bu bulguların daha geniş hasta serileri ve prospektif çalışmalarla desteklenmesi gerekmektedir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Strangüle herni, bağırsak rezeksiyonu, nötrofil/lenfosit oranı, NLO, C-reaktif protein, bağırsak iskemi, prediktif faktörler.Sistemik İmmün İnflamatuar İndeks(SII)

makaleler.baslik: Clinical outcomes of early versus standard liver transplantation in patients with alcohol-related liver disease: a meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Alkol İlişkili Karaciğer Hastalığında Erken ve Standart Karaciğer Nakli
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2323 hastayı içeren 12 çalışmalık meta-analizde erken ve standart karaciğer nakli arasında mortalite (RR 0,94; %95 CI 0,73-1,22) ve sağkalım (HR 1,10) benzer bulundu. Erken nakilde yatış süresi daha uzun (fark 5,24 gün) ve akut rejeksiyon riski hafif yüksek (RR 1,22) saptanırken greft kaybı farksızdı (RR 0,97).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: A 6-month abstinence period before listing patients with alcohol-related liver disease (ALD) for liver transplantation (LT) is the current standard practice at many transplant centers worldwide. Its prognostic validity is, however, debated because it has not been prospectively validated, and because many ALD patients do not survive long enough to make it onto the waitlist.
METHODS: A meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the guidelines put forth by Cochrane and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA). Three databases (PubMed/Medline, Scopus and Cochrane Library) were searched to identify studies comparing early (eLT) and standard LT (sLT).
RESULTS: Twelve studies comparing eLT and sLT for ALD were included, encompassing 2323 patients with ALD. Mortality [Risk ratio (RR) = 0.94, 95% Confidence Interval (CI): 0.73-1.22] and patient survival [Hazard Ratio (HR) = 1.10, 95% CI: 0.83-1.45] did not differ significantly between eLT and sLT. Any alcohol relapse was more frequent following eLT but did not reach significance in the primary analysis (RR = 1.37, 95%CI: 0.95-2.00). This association became statistically significant on leave-one-out and subgroup analyses. Early LT patients had a higher risk of acute graft rejection (RR = 1.22, 95% CI: 0.98-1.52) but comparable graft loss (RR = 0.97, 95% CI: 0.74-1.27). Post-operative risk of infection did not differ significantly (RR = 1.19, 95% CI: 0.80-1.77), but eLT was associated with longer hospitalization [Mean Difference (MD) = 5.24 days, 95% CI: 0.15-10.33].
CONCLUSIONS: Early LT offers survival similar to sLT and is a reasonable option when medical therapy fails. However, the equivocal evidence of higher morbidity and alcohol relapse, and the longer hospitalization, support careful multidisciplinary selection and close post-transplant surveillance, particularly among recipients with alcohol-related hepatitis.

makaleler.baslik: Normothermic regional perfusion in controlled donation after circulatory death liver transplantation: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis versus non-NRP and brain-death donors.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Dolaşım Ölümü Sonrası Karaciğer Naklinde Normotermik Bölgesel Perfüzyon
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1776 alıcıyı içeren 20 çalışmalık meta-analizde NRP kullanımı, standart cDCD'ye göre iskemik kolanjiyopatiyi (RR 0,16; %95 CI 0,09-0,28), greft kaybını (RR 0,41), alıcı ölümünü (RR 0,46) ve hepatik arter trombozunu (RR 0,51) anlamlı derecede azalttı; klinik sonuçların beyin ölümü donörlerine yaklaştığı bildirildi.
makaleler.ozet:
UNLABELLED: Normothermic regional perfusion (NRP) may mitigate ischemic injury in controlled donation after circulatory death (cDCD) liver transplantation. We updated the most recent meta-analysis (search closed June 2023) by incorporating subsequent evidence and comparing NRP with non-NRP cDCD and with donation after brain death (DBD). We performed a systematic review of five databases and random-effects meta-analyses; dichotomous outcomes were pooled as risk ratios, the Mantel-Haenszel estimator was preferred for rare events, pooled incidences used a logit-binomial model, risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I and certainty with GRADE. Twenty observational studies were included (1776 NRP-cDCD liver recipients). Versus non-NRP cDCD, NRP reduced ischemic cholangiopathy (risk ratio 0.16, 95% confidence interval 0.09-0.28; number needed to treat 9), graft loss (0.41, 0.32-0.54), recipient death (0.46, 0.34-0.62), hepatic artery thrombosis (0.51, 0.30-0.85), other biliary complications (0.49, 0.32-0.73) and primary non-function (0.51, 0.28-0.94); these reductions persisted after excluding grafts managed with ex situ machine perfusion. Versus DBD, no outcome differed significantly. Pooled ischemic cholangiopathy incidence was 1.8%, 12.7% and 1.2% with NRP, non-NRP and DBD. NRP markedly reduces ischemic cholangiopathy and improves other outcomes versus non-NRP cDCD, approaching DBD; the evidence remains observational, with moderate-to-serious risk of bias.

makaleler.baslik: The impact of tranexamic acid on graft function in liver transplantation: A randomised controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğer Naklinde Traneksamik Asitin Greft Fonksiyonuna Etkisi: RCT
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 89 hastalık randomize çalışmada, karaciğer naklinde TXA infüzyonu erken greft disfonksiyonunu anlamlı etkilemedi (%28'e karşı %13; p=0,08), ancak 1. gün AST düzeyini yükseltti (841'e karşı 622 IU/L; p=0,03). TXA uygulamasının transfüzyon ihtiyacı, tromboembolizm, yatış süresi ve sağkalım üzerinde plaseboya üstünlüğü gösterilemedi.
makaleler.ozet: Tranexamic acid (TXA) has been reported to reduce transfusion requirements in liver transplantation (LT). However, clinical evidence regarding the impact of TXA on graft function and other outcomes in liver transplant recipients remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of TXA on early allograft function following LT. In this prospective, single-centre, randomised study, 89 adult participants scheduled for LT were randomised to receive either TXA or placebo. After anaesthesia induction, a continuous infusion of TXA (10 mg/kg/h) was maintained until portal vein unclamping in the TXA group, while the control group received an equivalent volume of 0.9% saline. The anaesthesia protocol was standardised across both groups. Within 7 days post-transplantation, early allograft dysfunction occurred in 12 of 43 patients in the TXA group compared with 6 of 46 patients in the control group (28% vs 13%, P=0.08). Median aspartate transaminase level was significantly higher in the TXA group on post-operative day 1 compared to the control group (841 vs 622 IU/L, P=0.03). No significant differences were observed between the two groups in transfusion volume, acute kidney injury incidence, thromboembolic events, hospital length of stay, total hospitalisation costs, in-hospital mortality and 180-day survival. TXA administration in liver transplant patients failed to demonstrate beneficial effects on incidence of early graft dysfunction, transfusion requirements or other perioperative outcomes compared to placebo. The routine use of TXA must be undertaken with caution.

makaleler.baslik: Is ABO-incompatible Pediatric Liver Transplantation Really a Good Alternative: A Systematic Literature Review and Meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pediyatrik Karaciğer Naklinde ABO Uyumsuzluğu Gerçekten İyi Bir Alternatif mi?
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 8940 pediyatrik hastayı içeren 24 çalışmalık meta-analizde, ABO-i karaciğer transplantasyonunda 1, 5 ve 10 yıllık hasta sağkalımı ABO-c grubuna göre anlamlı derecede düşük bulundu (1 yıllık: OR 0,62, p<0,001). Enfeksiyon riski ABO-i grupta daha yüksekti (OR 1,81, p=0,006). Greft sağkalımı ile biliyer ve vasküler komplikasyonlarda fark saptanmadı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND/AIMS: To compare the clinical outcomes between ABO incompatible liver transplantation (ABO-i LT) and ABO compatible liver transplantation (ABO-c LT) in pediatric patients.
METHODS: In PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane databases, eligible articles were searched from inception to February 21, 2026. Outcome indicators, including patient survival rate, graft survival rate, rejection, biliary complications, infection complications, and vascular complications, were analyzed. Quality assessment was conducted by the Newcastle-Ottawa scale. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated by using MedCalc 22.009 (MedCalc Software, Ostend, Belgium).
RESULTS: A total of 24 studies with 8940 pediatric patients were included in the meta-analysis. Compared with ABO-c LT, the 1-year, 5-year, and 10-year patient survival rates of ABO-i LT were significantly lower (1-year: OR = 0.62, 95% CI: 0.49-0.77, P < 0.001; 5-year: OR = 0.64, 95% CI: 0.51-0.81, P < 0.001; 10-year: OR = 0.62, 95% CI: 0.43-0.90, P = 0.01). Pooled results showed that the risk of infection in ABO-i LT was significantly higher than in ABO-c LT (infection: OR = 1.81, 95% CI: 1.19-2.76, P = 0.006). The pooled results between the two groups showed no significant differences in the 3-year patient survival rate, graft survival rates, as well as the incidence of biliary and vascular complications. The subgroup analysis showed that 1-year, 5-year, and 10-year patient survival rates of ABO-i LT were also significantly lower than those of ABO-c LT in the late-era and living-donor subgroups. However, in the living-donor subgroup, there were significantly lower 1-year and 5-year graft survival rates and significantly higher risk of rejection in ABO-i LT.
CONCLUSION: In spite of evidence of non-inferior graft survival, findings of poorer patient survival and increased infectious complications should concern the surgeon before opting for an ABO-i donor and this option should be reserved only for unavailable group-matched donors in pediatric patients.

makaleler.baslik: External validation of the SALT-M score in living donor liver transplantation for acute-on-chronic liver failure.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Canlı Vericili Karaciğer Naklinde SALT-M Skorunun Dış Validasyonu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: KFSHRC (n=121) ve küresel (n=57) LDLT kohortlarında SALT-M skoru değerlendirildi; 1 yıllık mortalite %14,9 ve %21,1 oldu. Ayırt edicilik genel kohortta sınırlı bulundu (AUROC 0,56, %95 CI 0,40-0,72; ciddi ACLF'de 0,62). SALT-M bileşenleri mortaliteyle ilişkili bulunmadı; skor nakil adaylığı için evrensel bir eşik değer olmamalıdır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND & AIMS: The Sundaram Acute-on-Chronic Liver Failure-Liver Transplant Mortality (SALT-M) score predicts 1-year post-transplant mortality in patients with severe ACLF undergoing deceased donor liver transplantation (DDLT). Its performance in living donor liver transplantation (LDLT) is unknown.
METHODS: We externally validated SALT-M in two independent ACLF-LDLT cohorts: King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre (KFSHRC), Riyadh (n=121), and a global International LDLT Registry cohort (n=57). Discrimination (AUROC with 95% CI), calibration (observed-to-expected [O:E] ratio, calibration slope and intercept), and association with observed outcomes were assessed overall and, in the KFSHRC cohort, separately in ACLF grade 1 and severe ACLF (grades 2-3).
RESULTS: In the KFSHRC cohort, ACLF grade was 1 in 47.9%, 2 in 43.0%, and 3 in 9.1%; 1-year mortality was 14.9% (global cohort 21.1%). SALT-M predicted ≤30% mortality in 95.9% of the KFSHRC and 98.2% of the global cohort. Discrimination was limited and statistically inconclusive: AUROC 0.56 (95% CI 0.40-0.72) overall, 0.62 (0.42-0.81) in severe ACLF, and 0.51 (0.25-0.76) in ACLF-1. Calibration-in-the-large was acceptable (O:E 1.18, 95% CI 0.74-1.87) but the calibration slope was shallow (0.16). None of the five SALT-M components was associated with 1-year mortality; white blood cell count (OR 1.14, p=0.03) and female sex (OR 3.49, p=0.02) were. MELD-Na and MELD 3.0 were higher in non-survivors in the global cohort (p=0.03 and p=0.02).
CONCLUSIONS: In LDLT-dominant ACLF cohorts - evaluated largely outside the severe-ACLF population for which SALT-M was derived - discrimination could not be confirmed, reflecting profound spectrum restriction and few outcome events rather than demonstrated model failure. SALT-M should be applied cautiously as an adjunctive risk-stratification tool, not as a universal threshold for transplant candidacy.

tez.baslik: Canlı vericili karaciğer naklinde intraoperatif hepatik arter akım değerinin safra yolu komplikasyonları ile ilişkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Canlı Vericili Karaciğer Naklinde Hepatik Arter Akımı ve Biliyer Komplikasyonlar
tez.kisa_ozet: 121 hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, biliyer komplikasyon gelişenlerde intraoperatif ortalama hepatik arter akımı (50,5 ml/dk), gelişmeyenlere (106 ml/dk) göre anlamlı düşük saptanmıştır (p<0,001). Biliyer komplikasyon tahmininde eşik değer 52,5 ml/dk bulunmuş; düşük akım bağımsız risk faktörü (p=0,005) ve sağkalımla ilişkili belirlenmiştir (p=0,003).
tez.ozet: CANLI VERİCİLİ KARACİĞER NAKLİNDE İNTRAOPERATİF HEPATİK ARTER AKIM DEĞERİNİN SAFRA YOLU KOMPLİKASYONLARI İLE İLİŞKİSİ Giriş ve Amaç: Karaciğer nakli; son evre karaciğer hastalığı, akut karaciğer yetmezliği ve primer karaciğer kanserleri için definitif tedavi yöntemi olarak kabul edilmektedir. Canlı vericili karaciğer naklinde (CVKN) safra yolu komplikasyonları %30'lara ulaşabilen önemli morbidite ve mortalite nedenleri arasında yer almaktadır. Biliyer sistemin beslenmesinin temel olarak hepatik arteriyel sistem üzerinden sağlandığı düşünülmektedir. Bu çalışmanın amacı, intraoperatif ölçülen hepatik arter akım parametreleri ile postoperatif dönemde gelişen safra yolu komplikasyonları arasındaki olası ilişkiyi değerlendirmek ve bu parametrelerin öngördürücü değerini analiz etmektir. Materyal ve Metot: Bu çalışmaya, karaciğer nakli merkezimizde ardışık olarak sağ lob canlı vericili karaciğer nakli (CVKN) uygulanan 121 hasta dahil edildi. Çalışma kapsamında hastaların demografik özellikleri ile perioperatif verileri retrospektif olarak tarandı. Tüm hastalar postoperatif dönemde en az 12 ay süreyle takip edilmiş olup; safra yolu komplikasyonları, girişim (endoskopik, perkütan veya cerrahi) gerektiren biliyer kaçak ve striktürler olarak tanımlandı. İstatistiksel analizde; Mann-Whitney U testi, Student's t-testi ve Ki-kare testi kullanıldı. Risk faktörlerinin belirlenmesinde lojistik regresyon analizi, hepatik arter akım değerlerinin biliyer komplikasyonları ve genel sağkalım oranlarını öngördürücü gücünü ve eşik değerlerini saptamak amacıyla ise ROC eğrisi analizi yöntemlerinden yararlanıldı. Bulgular: Haziran 2022-Şubat 2025 tarihleri arasında CVKN uygulanan ve kriterleri karşılayan 121 hastanın verileri doğrultusunda, postoperatif biliyer komplikasyon gelişen grupta intraoperatif ortalama hepatik arter akım değerlerinin (20 hasta, 50,5 ml/dk), komplikasyon gelişmeyen gruba (101 hasta, 106 ml/dk) oranla anlamlı derecede düşük olduğu saptandı (p <0,001). Yapılan ROC analizi sonucunda da biliyer komplikasyonları tahmin etmede hepatik arter akımı içim bulunan eşik değer 52,5 ml/dk (%60 sensitivite, %95 spesifisite ve %88 doğruluk) olarak hesaplandı. Yapılan çok değişkenli lojistik regresyon analizinde; düşük hepatik arter akım değerleri ile siroz etiyolojisinin (kolestatik/kolestatik olmayan), biliyer komplikasyon gelişimi açısından bağımsız birer risk faktörü olduğu saptandı (sırasıyla p=0,005 ve p=0,020). Ayrıca, düşük hepatik arter akımının 12 aylık genel sağkalım üzerinde istatistiksel olarak anlamlı düzeyde olumsuz bir etkisi olduğu saptandı (p=0,003). Sonuç: Canlı vericili karaciğer naklinde intraoperatif hepatik arter akım ölçümü, biliyer komplikasyonların öngörülmesinde ve genel sağkalım oranlarının tahmininde kritik bir prognostik parametre olabileceğini düşünmekteyiz. Bu akım değerlerinin doğru değerlendirilmesi ve optimize edilmesi, biliyer komplikasyonların azaltılmasında belirleyici bir rol oynayabilir. Anahtar Sözcükler: Canlı vericili karaciğer nakli, hepatik arter akımı, biliyer komplikasyon

makaleler.baslik: Treatment Outcomes for Gastric Cancer With Positive Peritoneal Lavage Cytology or Localized Peritoneal Metastasis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: CY1 veya P1a Mide Kanserinde Tedavi Stratejilerinin Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: CY1 ve/veya P1a mide kanserli 1.181 hastanın incelendiği kohortta, neoadjuvan kemoterapi sonrası gastrektomi yapılanlarda 5 yıllık sağkalım %39,9 iken primer gastrektomi ve adjuvan kemoterapi grubunda %31,4 bulundu (p=0,01). En yüksek 5 yıllık sağkalım, kemoterapi sonrası P0CY0 dönüşümü sağlanarak gastrektomi yapılan grupta elde edildi (%50,5).
makaleler.ozet:
IMPORTANCE: In the era of modern systemic chemotherapy, the optimal treatment strategy for gastric cancer with positive peritoneal lavage cytology (CY1) and/or localized peritoneal metastasis (P1a) remains controversial.
OBJECTIVE: To explore the optimal treatment strategy for patients with gastric cancer with CY1 and/or P1a by comparing the outcomes of various therapeutic strategies.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study was a retrospective multicenter study set in 48 institutions of the Stomach Cancer Study Group in the Japan Clinical Oncology Group. Participants were patients with gastric cancer with CY1 and/or P1a, but no other distant metastases, who were treated in 2016 to 2022. Data were analyzed from July 2025 to May 2026.
EXPOSURE: Patients were stratified according to initial treatment: upfront gastrectomy (n = 838 [71%]) or upfront chemotherapy (n = 343 [29%]). The upfront chemotherapy group was further subdivided into chemotherapy alone (n = 205), gastrectomy after conversion to P0CY0 (n = 92), and nonconversion gastrectomy (n = 46) according to preoperative chemotherapy efficacy.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was overall survival (OS), and secondary outcomes included progression-free survival.
RESULTS: Among 1181 patients, the median (IQR) age was 72 (65-78) years; 725 patients (61%) were male and 456 (39%) were female. The overall 5-year OS rate was 25.0% (95% CI, 22.3%-28.0%), with a median survival time of 24.3 months. Upfront gastrectomy showed a significantly longer OS than upfront chemotherapy (5-year OS: 27.6% vs 19.0%; hazard ratio, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.69-0.93; P = .004). Among the multimodal treatment strategies, upfront chemotherapy followed by gastrectomy showed a significantly higher 5-year OS rate than upfront gastrectomy with postoperative chemotherapy (39.9%; 95% CI, 31.7%-50.2%, vs 31.4%; 95% CI, 27.6%-35.8%; P = .01). Gastrectomy alone and chemotherapy alone showed poor prognoses (10.3% and 3.2%, respectively). Notably, survival after gastrectomy following conversion to P0CY0 was the most favorable (5-year OS: 50.5%), whereas that without P0CY0 was modest (5-year OS: 17.2%).
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This study found that for gastric cancer with CY1 and/or P1a, upfront chemotherapy followed by gastrectomy resulted in a slightly higher 5-year OS rate than upfront gastrectomy followed by postoperative chemotherapy. Because gastrectomy after conversion to P0CY0 was associated with the most favorable survival, the development of more effective preoperative chemotherapy is warranted.

makaleler.baslik: Diagnostic Accuracy and Clinical Outcomes of the Intraoperative Intelligent Knife (REIMS) in Adult Oncologic Surgery: A Systematic Review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Erişkin Onkolojik Cerrahisinde İntraoperatif Akıllı Bıçağın Tanısal Doğruluğu ve Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Dokuz tümör tipinde 19 çalışmayı içeren sistematik derlemede, intraoperatif iKnife kullanımının duyarlılığı %60-100, özgüllüğü %80,7-100 saptandı. Yöntem marjin durumunu ve doku ayrımını yüksek doğrulukla belirledi; ancak reoperasyon, komplikasyon ve sağkalım gibi klinik sonuçlara etkisine yönelik kanıtlar sınırlı bulundu.
makaleler.ozet: Rapid intraoperative distinction between malignant and non-malignant tissue may improve resection completeness and reduce reoperation in cancer surgery. The intelligent knife (iKnife) integrates rapid evaporative ionisation mass spectrometry with electrosurgery to provide real-time tissue classification during surgery. This systematic review assessed the diagnostic accuracy and reported clinical outcomes of intraoperative iKnife use in adults undergoing oncological surgery. The review was prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251049162) and written according to PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-DTA, given the primary focus on diagnostic test accuracy. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, ClinicalTrials.gov, and the WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform were searched to 10 March 2026. Two reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias and certainty of evidence. Nineteen studies across nine tumour types were included, most of which were small prospective observational or feasibility cohorts. Reported sensitivity ranged from 60% to 100% and specificity from 80.7% to 100%, with high point estimates in ovarian, breast, colorectal and soft-tissue sarcoma settings. Downstream clinical outcome data were limited to margin status in 10 studies, reoperation in 3, complications in 4 and recurrence in 1, with no report of survival. The iKnife shows promise as a real-time intraoperative diagnostic adjunct, but evidence that it improves patient outcomes remains limited. Larger prospective multicentre studies with standardised outcomes and follow-up are required.

makaleler.baslik: Patient selection in those undergoing cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy for colorectal peritoneal metastases - systematic review and meta-analysis of prognostic factors in large cohorts.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolorektal Peritoneal Metastazlarda Sitoredüktif Cerrahi ve HIPEC İçin Hasta Seçimi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 45 çalışmayı içeren sistematik derlemede tamamlanmamış sitoredüksiyon, PCI ve Grade III-IV komplikasyonlar OS ve DFS'nin en güçlü prediktörleriydi. Kötü diferansiasyon, taşlı yüzük hücreli histoloji, lenf nodu pozitifliği, T4 evresi ve rektum yerleşimi daha kötü OS ile ilişkiliydi; neoadjuvan/adjuvan tedavilerin sağkalıma belirgin etkisi saptanmadı.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Cytoreductive surgery (CRS) with concurrent hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is a treatment for colorectal peritoneal metastases (CPM) which can offer a median overall survival of 41 months and improve quality of life. Judicious patient selection is critical for deriving the greatest benefit and avoiding overtreatment. This meta-analysis identifies prognostic factors associated with survival in large cohorts derived from prospectively maintained databases of CRS-HIPEC patient cohorts.
MATERIALS/METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to evaluate prognostic variables influencing overall survival (OS) and disease-free survival (DFS) in patients with CPM who underwent CRS-HIPEC.
RESULTS: Forty-five studies satisfied inclusion criteria for systematic review, with thirty-three studies included for qualitative synthesis. Incomplete cytoreduction, PCI, and grade III-IV complications were the strongest predictors of both OS and DFS. Tumour-specific factors associated with worse OS on pooled analysis included: poor differentiation, signet-ring cell pathology, nodal involvement, T4 stage, and rectal primary. Adjuvant/neoadjuvant systemic treatments had no significant impact on survival in this analysis. RAS mutations may be associated with poorer survival on exploratory analysis.
CONCLUSION: Survival after CRS-HIPEC was best determined by quantity of peritoneal disease (PCI) and the ability to achieve complete cytoreduction (CC-0). Major post-operative complications impact survival beyond short term morbidity. Baseline primary tumour-specific features also impacted survival.
